content.english_original: (a) These rules shall apply to all vessels upon the high seas and in all waters connected therewith navigable by seagoing vessels.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這些規則適用於所有在公海，以及任何跟公海相連、海船開得進去的水域裡的船隻。

content.english_original: All vessels must comply with these rules; that is, when they are navigating upon high seas and navigable waterways connected with high seas.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：只要在公海或是連著公海的航道上航行，所有船都必須遵守這些規則。

content.english_original: (b) Nothing in these rules shall interfere with the operation of special rules made by an appropriate authority for roadsteads, harbours, rivers, lakes or inland waterways connected with the high seas and navigable by seagoing vessels. Such special rules shall conform as closely as possible to these rules.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果當地主管機關對自己的港口、河流或內陸水道有特別規定，這套國際規則不會去干涉。但那些地方特別規定，內容要盡可能跟這套國際規則保持一致。

content.english_original: National authorities can implement special rules for the harbours, rivers or inland waterways connected with high seas and used by seagoing vessels. However, such rules must be as similar as possible to these rules.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：國家機關可以為自己的港口和內河制定特別規則，但內容要盡量跟國際規則差不多。

content.english_original: (c) Nothing in these rules shall interfere with the operation of any special rules made by the government of any state with respect to additional station or signal lights, shapes or whistle signals for ships of war and vessels proceeding under convoy, or with respect to additional station or signal lights or shapes for fishing vessels engaged in fishing as a fleet. These additional station or signal lights, shapes or whistle signals shall, so far as possible, be such that they cannot be mistaken for any light, shape or signal authorised elsewhere under these rules.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：各國政府可以為軍艦、護航船隊或集體捕魚的漁船隊制定額外的燈光、形狀或汽笛信號規則，這套規則不會干涉。但這些額外加裝的信號要盡量避免跟本規則的標準信號搞混。

content.english_original: The government of any state can introduce any special rules regarding additional station or signal lights, shapes or whistle signals for ships of war, vessels proceeding under convoy or vessels engaged in fishing, provided these additional lights, shapes or signals cannot be mistaken for any light, shape or signal authorised anywhere under these rules.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：各國政府可以給軍艦或漁船隊加裝特別的燈光或聲音信號，前提是不能跟現有的國際標準信號混淆。

content.english_original: (d) Traffic separation schemes may be adopted by the Organization for the purpose of these rules.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：國際海事組織（IMO）可以為了這些規則實施「分道航行制」（也就是海上的單行道系統）。

content.english_original: The Organization, IMO, may adopt traffic separation schemes for the purpose of these rules.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：國際海事組織可以制定海上的分道通航方案。

content.english_original: (e) Whenever the government concerned shall have determined that a vessel of any special construction or purpose cannot comply with the provisions of any of these rules with respect to the number, position, range or arc of visibility of lights or shapes, as well as to the disposition and characteristics of sound-signalling appliances, such a vessel shall comply with such other provisions in regard to the number, position, range or arc of visibility of lights or shapes, as well as to the disposition and characteristics of sound-signalling appliances, as her government shall have determined to be the closest possible compliance with these rules in respect of that vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果政府認定某些特殊構造或用途的船（比如潛艦或特殊工程船），真的沒辦法完全符合這些燈光或聲音信號的安裝規定，那這艘船就要遵守政府為它量身訂做、且盡可能最接近本規則的替代規定。

content.english_original: Where a vessel of special construction cannot comply with these rules with respect to the number, position, range or arc of visibility of lights and shapes, as well as to the disposition and characteristics of sound-signalling appliances, such a vessel must comply with other provisions as determined by her government, to be as close as possible to these rules.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：構造特殊的船如果真的裝不了標準規定的燈光或汽笛，就要按照當地政府規定，裝上盡可能最接近標準的替代設備。

content.english_original: (a) Nothing in these rules shall exonerate any vessel, or the owner, master or crew thereof, from the consequences of any neglect to comply with these rules or of the neglect of any precaution which may be required by the ordinary practice of seamen, or by the special circumstances of the case.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這些規則不能用來當作免責的金牌。如果因為沒遵守規則，或者缺乏海員應有的常識與警覺而導致出事，船隻、船東、船長和船員還是要負全責。

content.english_original: These rules do not relieve any vessel, owner, master or crew of/from the obligation of complying with these rules or of/from neglecting any precaution required by the ordinary practice of seamen.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：規則不能免除任何人遵守航海常規和安全防範措施的責任。

content.english_original: (b) In construing and complying with these rules due regard shall be had to all dangers of navigation and collision and to any special circumstances, including the limitations of the vessels involved, which may make a departure from these rules necessary to avoid immediate danger.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：在理解和遵守這些規則時，必須考慮到所有航行和碰撞的危險，以及當時的特殊情況（包含當下船隻的極限）。為了避免眼前的立即危險，有時候甚至必須破例不遵守這些規則。

content.english_original: To avoid collision, there may be occasions when it becomes ultimately essential to deviate from these rules. Any action taken in accordance of Rule 2(b) must be effective and result in passing other vessels safely.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：為了避免撞船，必要時可以打破常規。但根據這條規則（背離規則）所採取的任何行動，都必須能確實且安全地避開別人的船。

content.english_original: For the purpose of these rules, except where the context otherwise requires:
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：除非前後文有其他特別的意思，否則在本規則中以下詞彙的意思是：

content.english_original: (a) The word 'vessel' includes every description of water craft, including non-displacement craft, WIG craft and seaplanes, used or capable of being used as a means of transportation on water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「船隻 (vessel)」包含所有水上交通工具，不管是氣墊船、地效飛行器還是水上飛機，只要能在水上運輸的都算。

content.english_original: (b) The term 'power-driven vessel' means any vessel propelled by machinery.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「機動船 (power-driven vessel)」指的是用機器引擎作為動力的船。

content.english_original: (c) The term 'sailing vessel' means any vessel under sail provided that propelling machinery, if fitted, is not being used.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「帆船 (sailing vessel)」指的是正在用風帆航行的船，就算船上有裝引擎，只要當時沒開引擎就算帆船。

content.english_original: (d) The term 'vessel engaged in fishing' means any vessel fishing with nets, lines, trawls or other fishing apparatus which restrict manoeuvrability, but does not include a vessel fishing with trolling lines or other fishing apparatus which do not restrict manoeuvrability.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「捕魚中的船隻 (vessel engaged in fishing)」是指正在使用網具、延繩或拖網等會「限制船隻轉向能力」的漁具捕魚的船。如果用的漁具不影響轉向（比如只用拖釣繩），就不算在內。

content.english_original: (e) The word 'seaplane' includes any aircraft designed to manoeuvre on the water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「水上飛機 (seaplane)」包含任何可以在水面上操作的飛行器。

content.english_original: (f) The term 'vessel not under command' means a vessel which through some exceptional circumstance is unable to manoeuvre as required by these rules and is therefore unable to keep out of the way of another vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「失控船 (vessel not under command，簡稱 NUC)」指的是因為發生意外（例如引擎故障、舵壞掉），導致無法按照規則操控轉向，也無法避讓其他船的船隻。

content.english_original: (g) The term 'vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre' means a vessel which from the nature of her work is restricted in her ability to manoeuvre as required by these rules and is therefore unable to keep out of the way of another vessel. The term 'vessels restricted in their ability to manoeuvre' shall include but not be limited to:
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「操縱能力受限船 (vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre，簡稱 RAM)」指的是因為「工作性質」導致無法靈活轉向避讓的船。這類船隻包括但不限於：

content.english_original: (i)  a vessel engaged in laying, servicing or picking up a navigation mark, submarine cable or pipeline;
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(1) 正在鋪設、維修或收回航標、海底電纜或管線的船。

content.english_original: (ii) a vessel engaged in dredging, surveying or underwater operations;
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(2) 正在進行挖泥、測量或水下作業的船。

content.english_original: (iii) a vessel engaged in replenishment or transferring persons, provisions or cargo while underway;
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(3) 航行中正在進行海上補給，或運送人員、物資、貨物的船。

content.english_original: (iv) a vessel engaged in the launching or recovery of aircraft;
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(4) 正在讓飛機起降的船（像是航空母艦）。

content.english_original: (v) a vessel engaged in mine clearance operations;
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(5) 正在進行掃雷作業的船。

content.english_original: (vi) a vessel engaged in a towing operation such as severely restricts the towing vessel and her tow in their ability to deviate from their course.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(6) 正在進行拖船作業，而且這項作業嚴重限制了拖船和被拖的船改變航向的能力。

content.english_original: (h) The term 'vessel constrained by her draught' means a power-driven vessel which, because of her draught in relation to the available depth and width of navigable water, is severely restricted in her ability to deviate from the course she is following.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「吃水受限船 (vessel constrained by her draught，簡稱 CBD)」指的是吃水太深，導致相對於當下水域的深度和寬度，很難改變目前航向的機動船隻。

content.english_original: (i)  The word 'underway' means that a vessel is not at anchor, or made fast to the shore, or aground.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「航行中 (underway)」的意思是這艘船「沒有下錨」、「沒有綁在碼頭岸上」，也「沒有擱淺」。

content.english_original: (j) The words 'length' and 'breadth' of a vessel mean her length overall and greatest breadth.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：船的「長度 (length)」和「寬度 (breadth)」指的是船的總長度和最大寬度。

content.english_original: (k) Vessels shall be deemed to be in sight of one another only when one can be observed visually from the other.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：只有當兩艘船能用肉眼實實在在看到對方時，才算是「互相看見 (in sight of one another)」。

content.english_original: (l) The term 'restricted visibility' means any condition in which visibility is restricted by fog, mist, falling snow, heavy rainstorms, sandstorms or any other similar causes.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「能見度受限 (restricted visibility)」是指因為霧、霾、下雪、大暴雨、沙塵暴等類似原因，導致看不遠的情況。

content.english_original: (m) The term 'Wing-In-Ground (WIG) craft' means a multi-modal craft which, in its main operational mode, flies in close proximity to the surface by utilizing surface-effect action.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「地效飛行器 (WIG craft)」是指一種利用地面效應，主要在非常貼近水面的高度飛行的特殊交通工具。

content.english_original: All these definitions in rule 3 are self-explanatory and you must learn these by heart before offering yourself up for an oral examination.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：Rule 3 裡的這些定義都寫得很直白，你在去考口試之前一定要把它們背熟。

sections.section_title: SECTION I: CONDUCT OF VESSELS IN ANY CONDITION OF VISIBILITY

content.english_original: Rules in this section apply in any condition of visibility.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這一節的規則，不管外面天氣好壞、能見度高低，通通都要遵守。

content.english_original: Every vessel shall at all times maintain a proper lookout by sight and hearing as well as by all available means appropriate in the prevailing circumstances and conditions so as to make a full appraisal of the situation and of the risk of collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：每艘船隨時都要派人好好瞭望，不光是用眼睛看、耳朵聽，還得用上當時所有能用的儀器（像雷達），這樣才能全面掌握局勢和撞船的風險。

content.english_original: It is absolutely essential to maintain an all round lookout, at all times, by sight and hearing and by all available means including radar and AIS in all kinds of visibility. Extra lookouts should be posted in restricted visibility. The early detection of a target will help to make an early judgement of the situation, and of the risk of collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這點非常重要！任何時候、任何天氣，都要360度全方位戒備，除了眼看耳聽，雷達和AIS也要用上。遇到起霧或視線不好的時候，還要多加派人手去瞭望。越早發現目標，就能越早判斷情況，避開危險。

content.english_original: Every vessel shall at all times proceed at a safe speed so that she can take proper and effective action to avoid collision and be stopped within a distance appropriate to the prevailing circumstances and conditions.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：每艘船隨時都要保持「安全航速」，這個速度必須保證你能及時做出動作避開碰撞，而且能在當時情況允許的安全距離內把船停下來。

content.english_original: This rule directs every vessel to proceed at a safe speed. It is hard to say what a safe speed is in terms of a number of knots. However, the rule suggests that a vessel shall proceed at such a speed that she can take effective action to avoid collision and, that the vessel can be stopped within an appropriate distance. Every vessel must make its own judgement of what a safe speed is, by considering the factors given below.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這條規則要大家開安全速度。但安全速度不能死板地規定是幾節，總之就是要能有效避碰並煞得住車。每艘船要根據下面的因素，自己判斷當下的安全速度是多少。
口語翻譯：決定安全速度時，所有船都要考慮這幾點：(1) 能見度好不好；(2) 附近船多不多，有沒有擠著一堆漁船；(3) 自己的船好不好操控，特別要算好煞車距離跟轉向能力；(4) 晚上的話，岸上燈光或自己船上燈光反光會不會影響視線；(5) 風浪、海流大不大，附近有沒有暗礁等危險；(6) 船的吃水跟水深比起來夠不夠。

content.english_original: The above factors are to be considered by all vessels. State of visibility is one of the main factors to determine the safe speed of one's own vessel. Prudent masters will reduce speed to minimum in restricted visibility.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：上面這些是大家都得考慮的。能見度是決定安全速度最關鍵的因素。遇到視線不好的時候，謹慎的船長一定會把速度降到最低。
口語翻譯：如果有裝雷達而且開著，還要多考慮這幾點：(1) 雷達的效能跟限制在哪；(2) 你現在用的雷達距離刻度會不會有盲區；(3) 海浪、天氣或其他干擾會不會影響雷達抓目標；(4) 要知道小船、浮冰或漂流物在一定距離外雷達可能掃不到；(5) 雷達掃出來的船有幾艘、在哪裡、往哪跑；(6) 用雷達測量附近目標距離時，能不能幫你更準確評估目前的能見度。

content.english_original: In short, operational radar does not automatically mean that you can go full speed in all weathers and visibility.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：簡單來說，別以為有開雷達，就可以在任何天氣和視線下隨便開全速。

content.english_original: (a) Every vessel shall use all available means appropriate to the prevailing circumstances and conditions to determine if risk of collision exists. If there is any doubt such risk shall be deemed to exist.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：每艘船都要用盡當時所有可行的方法去判斷會不會撞船。只要心裡有一丁點懷疑「會不會撞到？」，那就要當作「會撞到」來處理！

content.english_original: First of all we have to ascertain how to determine risk of collision and what are the available means to determine the collision. This rule describes in section (d) that 'such risk shall be deemed to exist if the compass bearing of an approaching vessel does not appreciably change'. A bearing of an object can be taken with the magnetic compass on the monkey island, a gyro repeater in the bridge wings, a gyro repeater in the bridge, and the radar. Here the rule suggests that a vessel shall use all available means to determine collision risk.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：首先我們要知道怎麼判斷撞船風險。第(d)段說了最經典的一句話：「如果開過來的船，方位一直沒什麼變化，那就是有撞船風險」。你可以去羅經甲板看磁羅經、去駕駛台兩翼看電羅經，或者看雷達來測方位。總之就是能用的工具全用上。

content.english_original: (b) Proper use shall be made of radar equipment if fitted and operational, including long-range scanning to obtain early warning of risk of collision and radar plotting or equivalent systematic observation of detected objects.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果有雷達就要好好用，包括切換到長距離掃描來提早發現危險，並且要對掃到的目標做雷達測繪（標繪）或系統性的觀察。

content.english_original: Radar must be used efficiently, if fitted and operational. Regular switching to long ranges gives an early warning of the risk of collision, through manually plotting targets or by use of Automatic Plotting Aids.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：雷達不是擺著好看的。定時切換到長量程去掃描，能給你提早的警告，可以用手動測繪或自動雷達測繪輔助系統（ARPA）來追蹤目標。

content.english_original: (c) Assumptions shall not be made on the basis of scanty information, especially scanty radar information.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：千萬不要拿著一點點破銅爛鐵般的資訊就亂猜，尤其是雷達資訊還不完整的時候。

content.english_original: Scanty information means inadequate information. A watch officer must not make an assumption based on barely sufficient information. A watch officer must complete a proper radar plot of the target before making any judgement about the risk of collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「Scanty information」就是資訊不足。當值副官絕對不能靠感覺或一點點數據就下定論，必須先完成適當的雷達測繪，才能判斷到底會不會撞。
口語翻譯：判斷會不會撞船時要考慮：(1) 如果對方開過來，你在羅經上看它的方位幾乎沒變，那絕對會撞！(2) 有時候就算方位有明顯改變，還是有可能撞，特別是當你靠近超級大船、拖船船隊，或是雙方距離已經非常近的時候。

content.english_original: Whenever a target appears on the horizon, the watch officer must take a series of compass bearings to determine if a risk of collision exists. If the bearings of an approaching vessel, taken over sufficient time, do not change considerably then a risk of collision is deemed to exist. Sometimes, the bearing may change appreciably while the risk of collision still exists; for example, when approaching a large vessel at close range or when approaching a tow. While approaching a tow, make sure to take bearings of the forward end of the towing vessel and also of the astern of the vessel being towed.
content.chinese_translation:
口語翻譯：只要海平線上出現目標，當值副官就要連續測方位。如果量了一段時間發現方位沒變，那就是有碰撞危險。注意，遇到大船或拖船時，就算方位有變還是可能撞。遇到拖船隊時，記得要量拖船船頭和最後面被拖物體船尾的方位才準確。
(動畫可參考 www.seamanshiptutor.com/rorbook)

content.english_original: (a) Any action taken to avoid collision shall be taken in accordance with the rules of this part and shall, if the circumstances of the case admit, be positive, made in ample time and with due regard to the observance of good seamanship.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：所有避碰動作都要照著規則來，如果情況允許，動作要「明確（果斷）」、「提早做」，而且要符合優秀海員的常規。

content.english_original:
Any action taken to avoid collision must comply with the rules of Part B (Sailing and Steering Rules). There are three key points stressed here: 
(i)  positive action, (ii) action made in ample time, and (iii) action based on good seamanship.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：避碰要守法。這裡強調三個重點：(1) 動作要果斷，(2) 動作要提早，(3) 要展現良好的航海技術。

content.english_original: (b) Any alteration of course and/or speed to avoid collision shall, if the circumstances of the case admit, be large enough to be readily apparent to another vessel observing visually or by radar; a succession of small alterations of course and/or speed should be avoided.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：要避碰而轉向或改速度時，動作幅度要夠大！大到別人用肉眼或雷達一看就知道你在閃他。千萬不要像切香腸一樣，一點一點地小轉或小減速。

content.english_original: A succession of small alterations may not be readily apparent to another vessel, whereas a large alteration of course and/or speed should be apparent to the other vessel. In the case of small alterations, the other vessel will not be able to judge whether one's own vessel has taken action to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：你連續小幅度轉向，別的船根本看不出來。大動作轉向才能讓對方一目了然。如果你只轉一點點，對方會搞不清楚你到底有沒有在避讓他。

content.english_original: (c) If there is sufficient sea-room, alteration of course alone may be the most effective action to avoid a closequarters situation, provided that it is made in good time, is substantial and does not result in another closequarters situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果海面空間夠大，單純「轉向」通常是避免近距離危險最有效的方法。前提是你要提早轉、轉大一點，而且轉過去之後不能又跑去跟別艘船撞上。

content.english_original: If circumstances of the case admit, an alteration of course is the preferable action in order to avoid collision, provided it is made in ample time.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：情況允許的話，「轉向」是避碰的首選，但記得要提早轉。

content.english_original: (d) Action taken to avoid collision with another vessel shall be such as to result in passing at a safe distance. The effectiveness of the action shall be carefully checked until the other vessel is finally past and clear.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：你做的避碰動作，結果必須是跟對方保持安全距離交會。而且做完動作不能就去喝咖啡了，你要一直盯著，直到確認對方已經徹底安全通過、離你遠去為止。

content.english_original: The action taken to avoid collision must be positive and result in passing at a safe distance with the other vessel. The watch officer must observe the effectiveness of the action until the other vessel is definitely past and clear.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：動作要果斷，距離要安全。當值副官要一直觀察避碰動作有沒有效，直到別的船完全走遠為止。

content.english_original: (e) If necessary to avoid collision or allow more time to assess the situation, a vessel shall slacken her speed or take all way off by stopping or reversing her means of propulsion.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果有必要，為了避免相撞或是幫自己爭取更多時間來判斷情況，你應該減速，甚至把引擎停掉或倒車，把船完全煞停。

content.english_original: If a vessel needs more time to appraise the situation and it is determined that the other vessel is quite close, then the options of reducing speed or stopping engines must be used. This will buy her time and she can make the exact assessment of the situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果你需要時間思考，且對方已經很近了，別猶豫，直接減速或停車。這能幫你爭取時間，讓你看清楚局勢。

content.english_original:
(f) 
(i)  A vessel which, by any of these rules, is required not to impede the passage or safe passage of another vessel shall, when required by the circumstances of the case, take early action to allow sufficient sea-room for the safe passage of the other vessel.
(ii)  A vessel required not to impede the passage or safe passage of another vessel is not relieved of this obligation if approaching the other vessel so as to involve risk of collision and shall, when taking action, have full regard to the action which may be required by the rules of this part.
(iii)  A vessel the passage of which is not to be impeded remains fully obliged to comply with the rules of this part when the two vessels are approaching one another so as to involve risk of collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(1) 如果規則叫你「不要妨礙」別人，那你就要提早讓出夠大的空間給人家走。(2) 如果你因為太靠近導致快撞上了，你還是有責任不能妨礙對方，而且採取動作時必須嚴格遵守這部分的規則。(3) 至於那個「不被妨礙」的特權船，當快要撞上的時候，它自己也還是得遵守避碰規則，不能兩手一攤甚麼都不做。

content.english_original: A power-driven vessel, for example, is required by these rules to avoid impeding the safe passage of a vessel constrained by her draft. This rule directs the power-driven vessel to take early action to allow sufficient sea-room to the vessel constrained by her draught. A power-driven vessel shall take action to avoid collision with a vessel constrained by her draft in accordance with these rules and shall not alter course to port for a vessel constrained by her draft which is on her own port side. By definition a vessel constrained by her draft is a power-driven vessel (ref. rule 3h) and in such a situation the vessel constrained by her draft remains a give way vessel and power-driven vessel is a stand on vessel but takes action not to impede the passage of the vessel constrained by her draft. Since a vessel constrained by her draft remains fully obliged to comply with these rules, she is only faced with the problem of available depth and width of water, but she can always reduce speed to avoid collision. So she needs to determine as early as possible that a power-driven vessel on her own starboard side is taking substantial action so that she can continue on her own course. If power-driven vessel does not take action to avoid collision when she has a vessel constrained by her draft on her own port side, then according to rule 8f(iii) the vessel constrained by her draft must take action to avoid collision by reducing her speed or stopping engines.
content.chinese_translation:
口語翻譯：舉個例子，機動船不能妨礙吃水受限船（CBD）。機動船要提早讓出空間。但機動船如果遇到左舷有一艘吃水受限船，機動船絕對不能向左轉！而且吃水受限船本質上還是機動船，在交叉相遇時，如果它在你的左邊，它其實是「讓路船（give-way）」，而你是「直航船（stand-on）」，但你身為直航船的職責是「不妨礙它」。
對吃水受限船來說，它雖然不能隨便轉向，但它可以減速！所以它要提早看你（右舷的機動船）有沒有讓路。如果你死不讓，那根據8f(iii)，吃水受限船就要自己減速或停車來避免相撞了。

content.english_original:
Further examples of vessels that are not to impede the passage of other vessels include:
NARROW CHANNELS
A vessel of less than 20 metres in length or a sailing vessel shall not impede the passage of a vessel which can safely navigate only within a narrow channel or fairway.
A vessel engaged in fishing shall not impede the passage of any other vessel navigating within a narrow channel or fairway.
A vessel shall not cross a narrow channel or fairway if such crossing impedes the passage of a vessel which can safely navigate only within such a channel or fairway.
content.chinese_translation:
口語翻譯：其他「不能妨礙別人」的例子包含：
【狹窄水道】：小於20公尺的船或帆船，不能妨礙只能在狹水道航行的大船。漁船也不能妨礙別人。你橫越水道時，不能擋到只能在該水道正常航行的船隻。

content.english_original:
TRAFFIC SEPARATION SCHEMES
A vessel engaged in fishing shall not impede the passage of any vessel following a traffic lane.
A vessel of less than 20 metres in length or a sailing vessel shall not impede the safe passage of a power-driven vessel following a traffic lane.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：【分道通航制（TSS）】：漁船不能妨礙走在通航巷道內的船。小於20公尺的船或帆船，不能妨礙走在通航巷道內的機動船。

content.english_original: Please note from above explanations that the difference between 'shall avoid impeding' and 'shall not impede'. A power-driven vessel shall avoid impeding the safe passage of a vessel constrained by her draft. In TSS and narrow channel, a sailing vessel, a vessel engaged in fishing and a vessel less than 20m in length shall not impede the passage of a vessel following a lane or within the channel. 'Shall not impede' puts more emphasis on such vessels to stay clear.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：注意這裡的語氣差異：「應避免妨礙（shall avoid impeding）」和「不得妨礙（shall not impede）」。機動船對吃水受限船是「應避免妨礙」。但在TSS和狹水道，帆船、漁船和小船對大船是「不得妨礙」！「不得妨礙」的口氣更強硬，就是警告這些船一定要滾遠點、保持淨空。

content.english_original: (a) A vessel proceeding along the course of a narrow channel or fairway shall keep as near to the outer limit of the channel or fairway which lies on her starboard side as is safe and practicable.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：在狹窄水道或航道裡順著開的船，在安全可行的情況下，要盡量靠著自己右舷那一側的邊界走。

content.english_original: A vessel proceeding in a narrow channel shall keep to the outer limit of the channel or fairway which lies on its own starboard side. This way all vessels shall pass port to port.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：也就是說，大家都靠右邊走，這樣對向交會時，大家都是「左舷對左舷（port to port）」安全通過。

content.english_original:
(b) A vessel of less than 20 metres in length or a sailing vessel shall not impede the passage of a vessel which can safely navigate only within a narrow channel or fairway.
Rule 8(f) applies here.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：小於20公尺的船或帆船，不准妨礙那些只能在狹窄水道裡航行的大船。這裡適用前面提到的 Rule 8(f) 規則。

content.english_original:
(c) A vessel engaged in fishing shall not impede the passage of any other vessel navigating within a narrow channel or fairway.
Rule 8(f) applies here.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：漁船不准妨礙在狹窄水道裡航行的任何船隻。一樣適用 Rule 8(f)。

content.english_original: (d) A vessel shall not cross a narrow channel or fairway if such crossing impedes the passage of a vessel which can safely navigate only within such a channel or fairway. The latter vessel may use the sound signal prescribed in Rule 34(d) if in doubt as to the intention of the crossing vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果你橫越水道會擋到只能在裡面航行的大船，那你就不准橫越！如果大船懷疑你想硬闖，它可以狂按 Rule 34(d) 規定的警告汽笛聲。

content.english_original: Rule 8(f) applies here, since crossing impedes the safe passage of a vessel which can only safely navigate within the narrow channel. The vessel navigating in the narrow channel may sound at least five short and rapid blasts on the whistle.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果你橫越會擋路，就適用 Rule 8(f)。水道裡的大船可以連按「五短聲」以上的急促汽笛聲來警告你。

content.english_original:
(e) 
(i)  In a narrow channel or fairway when overtaking can take place only if the vessel to be overtaken has to take action to permit safe passing, the vessel intending to overtake shall indicate her intention by sounding the appropriate signal prescribed in Rule 34(c)
(i) . The vessel to be overtaken shall, if in agreement, sound the appropriate signal prescribed in Rule 34(c)(ii) and take steps to permit safe passing. If in doubt she may sound the signals prescribed in Rule 34(d).
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：在狹窄水道裡，如果你要超車，而且必須前面的船配合（比如稍微讓一下）你才過得去，那你就要鳴笛問他。如果前面的船同意，就鳴笛回覆並讓路；如果前面的船覺得有危險不同意，就可以按警告汽笛（五短聲）。

content.english_original:
If a vessel intends to overtake within a narrow channel she must seek permission of a vessel being overtaken by sounding the appropriate signal:
• Two prolonged blasted blasts followed by one short blast means 'I intend to overtake you on your starboard side.'
Two prolonged blasted blasts followed by two short blasts means 'I intend to overtake you on your port side.'
content.chinese_translation:
口語翻譯：想超車的船必須鳴笛討許可：
【兩長一短】：我要從你右邊超車。
【兩長兩短】：我要從你左邊超車。

content.english_original: If a vessel being overtaken agrees to the request then she shall sound one prolonged blasted, one short, one prolonged blasted and one short blast. If a vessel being overtaken is in any doubt or in disagreement then she shall sound at least five short and rapid blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果前船同意，就按【一長一短一長一短】。如果前船覺得不妥或反對，就狂按【至少五次短促汽笛聲】。

content.english_original:
(ii) This rule does not relieve the overtaking vessel of her obligation under Rule 13.
Rule 13 remains applicable here, meaning it is still the responsibility of the overtaking vessel to keep clear.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：就算前船同意讓你超車，你還是要遵守 Rule 13。也就是說，不管怎樣，「超車的人就是有責任避開被超的船」，自己要抓好安全距離。

content.english_original: (f) A vessel nearing a bend or an area of a narrow channel or fairway where other vessels may be obscured by an intervening obstruction shall navigate with particular alertness and caution and shall sound the appropriate signal prescribed in Rule 34(e).
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：船開到水道的彎角，或是視線被障礙物擋住的地方時，要特別提高警覺，而且要按 Rule 34(e) 規定的汽笛聲來提醒對向。

content.english_original: A vessel nearing a bend shall sound one prolonged blasted blast to indicate her presence.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：快到彎角時，要按【一長聲】汽笛，告訴別人「我來了」。

content.english_original: (g) Any vessel shall, if the circumstances of the case admit, avoid anchoring in a narrow channel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：情況允許的話，任何船都不要在狹窄水道裡面下錨（會擋住整條路）。

content.english_original: (a) This rule applies to traffic separation schemes adopted by the Organization and does not relieve any vessel of her obligation under any other rule.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這條規則專門管 IMO 制定的「分道通航制」（海上的單行道系統）。但記住，走在裡面不代表你可以無視其他避碰規則。

content.english_original: This rule is only applicable to traffic separation schemes adopted by IMO. All vessels following traffic separation schemes are not relieved of their obligations under any other rule; which means all other rules remain applicable in traffic separation schemes.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這只適用於 IMO 認可的 TSS。你在 TSS 裡面還是要遵守所有的交叉相遇、追越、對遇等避碰規則。
口語翻譯：使用分道通航制的船必須：(1) 走在正確的車道，順著車流方向開；(2) 盡量遠離中間的分隔線或分隔區；(3) 盡量從車道的頭尾進出，如果非得從側邊進出，角度要越小越好（也就是順著車流切入切出）。

content.english_original: A vessel using a traffic separation scheme shall proceed in the appropriate lane in the general direction of the traffic flow for that lane (+/- 5°) and if possible keep clear of the traffic separation line or the separation zone. Joining and leaving is preferred at the termination points but when joining or leaving from the sides, it shall be done at small angle to the general direction of traffic flow.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：順著車流開（航向大約正負5度內），盡量遠離分隔區。最好從頭尾進出，從側邊進出時角度要小。

content.english_original: (c) A vessel shall, so far as practicable, avoid crossing traffic lanes but if obliged to do so shall cross on a heading as nearly as practicable at right angles to the general direction of traffic flow.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：能不橫越車道就不要橫越。如果非得橫越，船頭的朝向（Heading）要盡可能跟車流方向成「90度直角」。

content.english_original:
Crossing traffic lanes is not recommended here, but when crossing cannot be avoided it shall be performed with a heading at right angles to the general direction of traffic flow. Note here that it is the 'heading' which must be at right angles to the traffic flow when crossing. That means that it is not the 'true course made good' but the 'true course to steer' which matters, as demonstrated in the following animations.
(Please visit www.seamanshiptutor.com/rorbook to download animations on Rule 10.)
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：不建議橫越，一定要橫越時，船頭要維持90度直角。請注意！這裡說的是「船頭朝向（Heading/ true course to steer）」，而不是你實際被水流推移後走出的「實際航跡（course made good）」。不要為了抵銷水流而斜著船身開，別人會以為你想匯入車道。

content.english_original:
(d) 
(i)  A vessel shall not use an inshore traffic zone when she can safely use the appropriate traffic lane within the adjacent traffic separation scheme. However, vessels of less than 20 metres in length, sailing vessels and vessels engaged in fishing may use the inshore traffic zone.
(ii)  Notwithstanding sub-paragraph (d)
(i) , a vessel may use an inshore traffic zone when en route to or from a port, offshore installation or structure, pilot station or any other place situated within the inshore traffic zone, or to avoid immediate danger.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(1) 如果你能安全地走外面的 TSS 車道，就不准走「沿岸通航區（inshore traffic zone）」。但是，小於20公尺的船、帆船和漁船可以走沿岸區。(2) 如果你要進出港口、海上設施、引水站，或者為了躲避緊急危險，那大船也可以借走沿岸區。

content.english_original: Through vessels shall use a traffic separation scheme and not use inshore traffic zones. But sailing vessels, vessels engaged in fishing and vessels less than 20 metres in length may use inshore traffic zones.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：路過的大船乖乖走 TSS，不要擠沿岸區。沿岸區是留給小船、帆船和漁船走的。
口語翻譯：除非你是要橫越、切入或切出車道，否則不准開進分隔區或跨越分隔線。例外情況：(1) 遇到緊急危險要躲避；(2) 你要在分隔區裡面捕魚。
口語翻譯：只有在這四種情況下，你可以踩進分隔區或分隔線：1. 發生緊急情況 2. 在分隔區捕魚 3. 橫越車道 4. 進出車道。

content.english_original: (f) A vessel navigating in areas near the terminations of traffic separation schemes shall do so with particular caution.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：開到 TSS 車道的頭尾端附近時，要特別小心（因為那裡會有各種進出、匯流的船）。

content.english_original: (g) A vessel shall so far as practicable avoid anchoring in a traffic separation scheme or in areas near its terminations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：盡可能不要在 TSS 車道裡面，或者在車道的頭尾端附近下錨。

content.english_original: (h) A vessel not using a traffic separation scheme shall avoid it by as wide a margin as is practicable.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果你不走這個 TSS 系統，那就盡可能離它越遠越好，不要在旁邊蹭。

content.english_original:
(i)  A vessel engaged in fishing shall not impede the passage of any vessel following a traffic lane.
Rule 8(f) applies here.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：漁船不准妨礙走在 TSS 車道裡的任何船隻。適用 Rule 8(f)。

content.english_original:
(j) A vessel of less than 20 metres in length or a sailing vessel shall not impede the safe passage of a power-driven vessel following a traffic lane.
Rule 8(f) applies here.
Safe passage refers to power-driven vessel which is required to follow the appropriate lane if navigating in the area. For a power-driven vessel, a lane is the safe passage. On the other hand, passage is for any vessel which is following the lane, such as if a sailing vessel is following a lane then a fishing vessel shall not impede the passage of any vessel following a traffic lane (Rule 10(i) ).
content.chinese_translation:
口語翻譯：小於20公尺的船或帆船，不准妨礙走在車道裡的機動船。適用 Rule 8(f)。
注意：「安全通行（safe passage）」是指機動船在這裡只能走這個車道，車道就是它的安全通行空間。而「通行（passage）」則是指任何走在車道裡的船，比如說一艘帆船乖乖走在車道裡，這時候漁船（根據10
(i) ）也不能妨礙這艘帆船的通行。

content.english_original: (k) A vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre when engaged in an operation for the maintenance of safety of navigation in a traffic separation scheme is exempted from complying with this rule to the extent necessary to carry out the operation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果是為了維護航道安全而在裡面施工的「操縱能力受限船」，為了能順利施工，可以豁免不遵守這條 TSS 規則。

content.english_original: (l) A vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre when engaged in an operation for the laying, servicing or picking up of a submarine cable, within a traffic separation scheme, is exempted from complying with this rule to the extent necessary to carry out the operation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果是在 TSS 裡面鋪設、維修或撈起海底電纜的「操縱能力受限船」，為了工作需要，也可以豁免不遵守這條規則。

content.english_original: The above two types of vessel are exempted from complying with this rule because of the nature of their work. A vessel engaged in an operation for the maintenance of safety of navigation can steer in any direction within the traffic separation scheme (TSS) as may be required by the extent of the operation. Similarly, a vessel engaged in an operation for the laying, servicing or picking up of a submarine cable within a traffic separation scheme is exempted so as to be able to carry out the operation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：上面這兩種船因為工作性質特殊，擁有特權。像是維修航標的船，可以在 TSS 裡面愛往哪開就往哪開。修海底電纜的船也是一樣，因為施工需要，所以可以不守 TSS 規則。

sections.section_title: SECTION II: CONDUCT OF VESSELS IN SIGHT OF ONE ANOTHER

content.english_original: Rules in this section apply to vessels in sight of one another.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這一節的規則，只在你跟其他船互相看得到對方的情況下才適用。

content.english_original: This rule is here to emphasise the point that this section applies only to vessels when in sight of one another. Remember that Section I applies in all conditions of visibility, while Section II applies only to vessels in sight of one another.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這條規則是在特別強調，第二節的規定只有在「互相看得見」時才管用。別忘了，第一節是不管能見度好壞都要守，第二節則是看得到彼此才要守。
口語翻譯：當兩艘帆船快要撞上的時候，其中一艘要讓路：(1) 如果兩艘船受風面不同，左舷受風的船要讓路；(2) 如果受風面一樣，位在上風處的船要讓給下風處的船；(3) 如果你是左舷受風，看到上風處有艘船，但你搞不清楚對方是左舷還是右舷受風，那你要讓路。

content.english_original: This rule makes clear that it applies only to two sailing vessels involved in risk of collision. The above actions do not involve power-driven vessels, but when a power-driven vessel sees two sailing vessels then she can determine the course of action taken by either of the sailing vessels.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這條規則只適用於「兩艘帆船」快撞上的情況。機動船不適用這條，但機動船如果看到兩艘帆船在會車，可以靠這條規則來判斷它們接下來會怎麼開。

content.english_original: This part of the rule can easily be understood by the following diagrams (Figure 1).
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這個規則看一下圖解（圖一）就很容易懂了。

content.english_original: (b) For the purposes of this rule the windward side shall be deemed to be the side opposite to that on which the mainsail is carried or, in the case of a square-rigged vessel, the side opposite to that on which the largest fore-and-aft sail is carried.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：在這條規則裡，「上風側」就是指主帆所在的那一面的反方向；如果是橫帆船，那就是最大縱帆所在位置的反方向。

content.english_original: (a) Notwithstanding anything contained in the rules of Part B, Sections I and II, any vessel overtaking any other shall keep out of the way of the vessel being overtaken.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：不管 Part B 第一節和第二節寫了什麼，只要你在「超車（追越）」，超車的船就是要負全責，絕對要避開前面的船。

content.english_original: This rule overrides all other rules in Sections I and II of Part B. Which means it is the responsibility of the overtaking vessel to keep clear. A point to note here is that this rule overrides all the other rules in Sections I and II, including Rule 18 which involves responsibilities between vessels. When overtaking takes place in clear visibility it is the responsibility of the overtaking vessel to keep clear. While it may be a sailing vessel overtaking a power-driven vessel or a vessel engaged in fishing overtaking a sailing vessel, it remains the responsibility of the overtaking vessel to keep clear.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這條規則是「無敵星星」，效力大過第一節和第二節的所有規則（包含 Rule 18 船種間的責任）。只要視線清楚你在超車，你就是要閃。就算你是帆船去超機動船，或是漁船去超帆船，不好意思，超車的人就是要讓！

content.english_original: (b) A vessel shall be deemed to be overtaking when coming up with another vessel from a direction more than 22.5 degrees abaft her beam, that is, in such a position with reference to the vessel she is overtaking, that at night she would be able to see only the stern light of that vessel but neither of her sidelights.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：什麼叫超車？只要你從對方正橫後方大於 22.5 度的方向開過來，就算超車。簡單來說，在晚上的時候，你在那個位置只能看到對方的「尾燈」，看不到他的紅綠舷燈。

content.english_original: In the above diagram (Figure 2a), B is overtaking A because it is coming up from more than 22.5° abaft the beam. At night, B can initially see A's stern light alone. C is a crossing vessel as she can see a sidelight of A at night. In case of D, the rule states that if a vessel is coming up more than 22.5° and vessel D is exactly at 22.5° this makes her a crossing vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：看圖 2a，B 就是在超 A 的車，因為他在大於 22.5 度的後面。晚上 B 只能看到 A 的尾燈。C 則是交叉相遇，因為他看得到 A 的舷燈。至於 D 如果剛好卡在 22.5 度的邊界線上，規則說大於才算超車，所以剛好 22.5 度算是「交叉相遇」。

content.english_original: (c) When a vessel is in any doubt as to whether she is overtaking another, she shall assume that this is the case and act accordingly.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果你心裡懷疑自己到底算不算在超車？那就當作「你就是在超車」，乖乖讓路。

content.english_original: Again, looking at Figure 2a, vessel D explains this part of the rule. At night vessel D might sometimes see vessel A's stern light and sometime vessel A's green sidelight, which will create a doubt. In such a situation vessel D shall assume the responsibility of overtaking and keep clear of vessel A.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：再拿剛剛的 D 船當例子。晚上的時候，D 船可能一下看到尾燈，一下又看到綠色舷燈，會有點搞不清楚狀況。這時候 D 船就該乖乖扛下「超車船」的責任，主動避讓 A 船。

content.english_original: (d) Any subsequent alteration of the bearing between the two vessels shall not make the overtaking vessel a crossing vessel within the meaning of these rules or relieve her of the duty of keeping clear of the overtaken vessel until she is finally past and clear.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：超車的過程中，就算兩艘船的相對方位改變了，超車船也不會因此變成「交叉相遇船」，超車船的避讓責任會一直跟著你，直到你徹底且安全地超過對方為止。

content.english_original:
In an overtaking situation when vessel B advances so as to cross the line of two points abaft A's beam, vessel B does not become a crossing vessel. Vessel B remains the overtaking vessel until finally past and clear.
(Please visit www.seamanshiptutor.com/rorbook to download animations on Rule 13.)
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：在超車時，當 B 船開到 A 船側後方 22.5 度那條線的前面時，B 船不會因此變成交叉相遇。B 船「一日超車，終身超車」，直到完全超過並拉開距離為止。

content.english_original:
(a) When two power-driven vessels are meeting on reciprocal or nearly reciprocal courses so as to involve risk of collision each shall alter her course to starboard so that each shall pass on the port side of the other.
(b) Such a situation shall be deemed to exist when a vessel sees the other ahead or nearly ahead and by night she would see the mast head lights of the other in a line or nearly in a line and or both sidelights and by day she observes the corresponding aspect of the other vessel.
(c) When a vessel is in any doubt as to whether such a situation exists she shall assume that it does exist and act accordingly.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(1) 當兩艘「機動船」迎面開過來快撞上時，兩艘船都要向右轉，大家從對方的左邊（左舷對左舷）錯開。(2) 怎麼判斷是對頭相遇？白天看船頭是不是正對著你，晚上看對方的桅燈是不是排成一直線，或是同時看到對方的紅綠兩盞舷燈。(3) 如果你懷疑到底是不是對頭相遇，那就當作「是」，雙方都乖乖向右轉。

content.english_original: Please note this rule concerns two power-driven vessels. Rule 14 differs from other rules in Section II by placing equal responsibility on each power-driven vessel to keep out of each other's way. Both power-driven vessels shall alter course to starboard and pass port of each other. When two power-driven vessels are nearly end-on, a doubt may develop as to whether a head-on situation exists or not. In such cases vessels will assume the case of head-on situation and take action accordingly.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：請注意，這條只管「兩艘機動船」。這條規則跟其他規則不一樣的地方在於，兩艘船的責任是「一人一半」，大家都要閃！兩邊都要向右轉、左舷交會。如果兩艘船看起來好像有點偏又好像是對著頭，只要有懷疑，一律當成對頭相遇來處理。

content.english_original: When two power-driven vessels are crossing so as to involve risk of collision, the vessel which has the other on her own starboard side shall keep out of the way and shall, if the circumstances of the case admit, avoid crossing ahead of the other vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：當兩艘機動船交叉相遇快撞上時，看到別人在自己「右舷」的那艘船要負責讓路！而且情況允許的話，不准從人家的船頭前面搶著穿過去（要從人家屁股後面繞）。

content.english_original: Similar to Rule 14, this rule also concerns two power-driven vessels. In the above diagram (Figure 3), power-driven vessel A is the give-way vessel. The latter part of the rule emphasises that the give-way vessel shall avoid crossing ahead of the other vessel. The preferred action under this rule is an alteration of course to starboard to pass astern of the stand-on vessel. One may be to alter course to port and steer parallel to the other vessel's course (which satisfies the avoiding crossing ahead condition) and then reassess the situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：跟 Rule 14 一樣，這也只針對機動船。在圖3中，A 船是讓路船。規則強調，讓路船不要搶船頭。最標準的做法是「向右轉」，從直航船的屁股後面過。另一個方法是向左轉，跟對方平行開（這樣也不算搶船頭），然後再看情況決定怎麼做。

content.english_original: Every vessel which is directed to keep out of the way of another vessel shall, so far as possible, take early and substantial action to keep well clear.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：被規定要讓路的船，只要情況允許，一定要「早點動作」，而且「動作要大」，乖乖躲開。

content.english_original: Early action means that the other ship will not be panicked into assuming you are not going to alter your course/speed. Substantial means that your manoeuvre is more easily spotted by the ship. As stated in Rule 8, a succession of small alterations is not encouraged as it will not be easily spotted by the other vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：提早做動作，對方才不會嚇出心臟病以為你不想讓。動作要大，別人才看得懂你在幹嘛。就像 Rule 8 說的，一點一點微調是大忌，因為別人根本看不出來。

content.english_original:
(a) 
(i)  Where one of two vessels is to keep out of the way the other shall keep her course and speed.
(ii)  The latter vessel may however take action to avoid collision by her manoeuvre alone, as soon as it becomes apparent to her that the vessel required to keep out of the way is not taking appropriate action in compliance with these rules.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(1) 如果對方要讓路，那身為「直航船」的你，要保持原來的航向和速度。(2) 但是，一旦你發現那個該讓路的傢伙根本沒在閃，你就可以自己採取避讓動作，不用傻傻等撞。

content.english_original: In a close-quarter situation between two vessels, one vessel shall keep out of the way of the other vessel; and the other vessel shall keep her course and speed. This does not mean that the stand-on vessel shall never take action to avoid collision. A stand-on vessel may take action if it is apparent to her that the give-way vessel is not taking appropriate action to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：在近距離會車時，一個讓路，一個保向保速。但這不代表直航船就只能死命往前開等撞。只要你覺得讓路船在裝死沒動作，你隨時可以自己閃。

content.english_original: (b) When, from any cause, the vessel required to keep her course and speed finds herself so close that collision cannot be avoided by the action of the give-way vessel alone, she shall take such action as will best aid to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果不管什麼原因，直航船發現兩艘船已經近到「光靠讓路船閃也來不及了」，那直航船就「必須」採取最能避免撞船的動作。

content.english_original: When a stand-on vessel finds herself so close to a give-way vessel and determines that collision cannot be avoided by the give-way vessel alone, the stand-on vessel shall take action to avoid the collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果直航船發現雙方距離已經太近，讓路船自己也救不回來時，直航船就一定要出手自救。

content.english_original: (c) A power-driven vessel which takes action in a crossing situation in accordance with sub-paragraph (a)(ii) of this Rule to avoid collision with another power-driven vessel shall, if the circumstances of the case admit, not alter course to port for a vessel on her own port side.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：在交叉相遇時，如果機動船（直航船）決定自己閃避左邊那艘不守規矩的船，情況允許的話，千萬「不要向左轉」。

content.english_original: When a stand-on vessel takes action for a give-way vessel on her port side, the stand-on vessel must not alter course to port side because the give-way vessel may wake up instantly and take action to starboard side in accordance to these rules, which may make the situation even worse. When a vessel, obliged by these rules to stand-on, finds that another vessel is taking insufficient action to avoid collision, then the stand-on vessel should not alter course to port. Implicitly, the stand-on vessel is to alter to starboard, or alter speed. When a stand-on vessel chooses to alter, it should make the alteration large, radical and unmistakable.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：為什麼直航船要閃左邊的船時不能向左轉？因為那艘裝死的讓路船可能會突然醒過來，然後按照規則「向右轉」，結果你們兩個剛好轉向同一個方向，撞得更慘！所以直航船不要向左轉，言下之意就是你要嘛向右轉，要嘛減速。而且一旦決定轉，就要轉得夠大、夠果斷！

content.english_original: (d) This rule does not relieve the give-way vessel of her obligation to keep out of the way.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這條規則不是給讓路船的免死金牌，讓路船的避讓責任一點也沒有少。

content.english_original: A give-way vessel is not relieved of her obligation of keeping clear under this rule. In other words, a give-way vessel shall not use this rule as an excuse and not take any action in a close-quarter situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：讓路船不能用「反正直航船最後會閃我」當藉口，你在近距離狀況下該閃就是要閃。

口語翻譯：除 Rule 9(狹水道)、10(TSS) 和 13(超車) 之外，船隻的「階級表」如下：
(a) 機動船最可憐，要讓失控船(NUC)、操縱受限船(RAM)、漁船和帆船。
(b) 帆船要讓失控船(NUC)、操縱受限船(RAM)和漁船。
(c) 漁船盡可能要讓失控船(NUC)和操縱受限船(RAM)。

content.english_original: The important point to note here is that this rule does not apply fully in narrow channels (Rule 9) and traffic separation schemes (Rule 10). There are special instructions to sailing vessels, vessels engaged in fishing and vessels of less than 20m in length when operating in TSS and narrow channels; but give-way and stand-on duties will remain as per this rule. In an overtaking situation (Rule 13) this rule is not applicable at all. Otherwise all the above responsibilities are applicable and are self-explanatory.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：重點來了！在狹水道和 TSS 裡面，這條規則不完全適用（因為帆船、漁船、小船在那裡不能妨礙別人）。如果是「超車」的情況下，這條規則直接作廢（超車的永遠要讓）。除此之外，上面這個「船種階級表」都是成立的。

content.english_original:
(d) 
(i)  Any vessel other than a vessel not under command or a vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre shall, if the circumstances of the case admit, avoid impeding the safe passage of a vessel constrained by her draught, exhibiting the signals in Rule 28.
(ii)  A vessel constrained by her draught shall navigate with particular caution having full regard to her special condition.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(1) 除了失控船(NUC)和操縱受限船(RAM)以外，其他任何船只要情況允許，都應該避免妨礙「吃水受限船(CBD)」的安全通行。(2) 吃水受限船自己也要知道自己的處境很特別，開船要特別小心。

content.english_original: Any vessel other than a vessel not under command or a vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre shall avoid impeding the safe passage of the vessel constrained by her draught. This does not make a deep draught vessel a privileged vessel, as she can always reduce her speed if she cannot alter her course because of available depth and width of the water. So she shall navigate with caution having full regard to her special condition.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：除了 NUC 和 RAM，其他船都要避免妨礙吃水受限船。但注意！吃水受限船不是拿著無敵免死金牌，因為就算水太淺不能轉向，它還是可以減速啊！所以吃水受限船自己要格外小心。

content.english_original: (e) A seaplane on the water shall, in general, keep well clear of all vessels and avoid impeding their navigation. In circumstances, however, where risk of collision exists, she shall comply with the rules of this part.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：水上飛機在水面上時，基本上要閃開所有的船，不要妨礙人家。但如果真的快撞上了，水上飛機就要把自己當成普通機動船，乖乖遵守這些避碰規則。

content.english_original: A seaplane shall avoid impeding the passage of all vessels. If risk of collision exists she shall comply with rules of this part as a power-driven vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：水上飛機別去惹其他的船。如果快撞上了，水上飛機的地位就跟機動船一樣，照規矩來。
口語翻譯：(1) 地效飛行器在起飛、降落或貼著海面飛的時候，要躲開所有船隻，別去妨礙人家。(2) 如果地效飛行器是在水面上滑行，那就把它當成一般的機動船，遵守避碰規則。

content.english_original: A WIG craft, in its main operational mode, flies just a few metres above the water surface utilising the surface effect. When taking off, landing and flying near the surface, a WIG craft shall keep clear of all other vessels and avoid impeding their navigation. When operating on the water surface like a normal power-driven vessel, she shall comply with the rules of this part as power-driven vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：地效飛行器平常是利用地面效應，貼著水面幾公尺飛。在天上飛（含起降）的時候，閃開所有的船。如果是掉在水面上開，那它就是一艘普通的機動船，照規矩讓路。[cite: 1]

sections.section_title: SECTION III: CONDUCT OF VESSELS IN RESTRICTED VISIBILITY

rules.Rule_Title: Conduct of vessels in restricted visibility

content.english_original: (a) This rule applies to vessels not in sight of one another when navigating in or near an area of restricted visibility.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這條規則只在能見度受限的區域（或附近），而且「雙方肉眼互相看不到」的時候才適用。

content.english_original: This rule is only applicable in restricted visibility when vessels cannot see each other. As soon as two vessels come in sight of each other this rule does not apply. In restricted visibility, in addition to this rule, Section I of Part B is also applicable.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這只管大霧等互相看不到的情況。只要肉眼一看到對方，這條規則馬上作廢（換回第二節）。在大霧中，除了這條，別忘了 Part B 第一節的基本功還是要遵守。

content.english_original: (b) Every vessel shall proceed at a safe speed adapted to the prevailing circumstances and conditions of restricted visibility. A power-driven vessel shall have her engines ready for immediate manoeuvre.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：每艘船都要根據當時視線不好的情況開安全速度。機動船的引擎必須處於「隨時可以操縱」的備便狀態（不能搞什麼無人機艙保養）。

content.english_original: Considering the restricted visibility, every vessel shall proceed at safe speed. A power-driven vessel shall have engines ready for immediate manoeuvre.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：視線不好就是要減速。機動船要把引擎熱著，隨時準備停車或倒車。

content.english_original: (c) Every vessel shall have due regard to the prevailing circumstances and conditions of restricted visibility when complying with the rules of Section I of this part.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：在遵守第一節那些規則（像是安全速度、瞭望）時，每艘船都要把當下能見度不好的狀況考慮進去。

口語翻譯：如果你的肉眼看不到，是「單靠雷達」發現別人的，你要判斷會不會太近或撞上。如果要撞上了，就要提早做動作。如果是靠「轉向」來避碰，盡可能「不要做」下面兩件事：
(1) 不要為了正橫前面的船向左轉（除非你是在超他的車）。
(2) 船在你的正橫或正橫後方，不要朝著他的方向轉。

content.english_original:
There are a few points to be carefully considered here. This part only applies if a target is detected by radar alone. The part is also only applicable to the targets with risk of collision. The rule obliges one to avoid alteration of course to port for vessel forward of one's own vessel's beam, and to avoid alteration of course towards the vessel abaft of one's own vessel's beam. For ease of understanding, the ways to alter in each case are as follows:
(i)   Alter course to starboard for a vessel forward of the beam.
(ii)  Alter course to starboard for a vessel on or abaft the port beam.
(iii)  Alter course to port for a vessel on or abaft starboard beam.
content.chinese_translation:
口語翻譯：這裡有幾個重點要小心。這只適用於「單靠雷達」發現、而且「有碰撞危險」的目標。規則要你不准對前面的船向左轉，也不准朝後面的船轉。最簡單的轉向口訣就是：
(1) 前面的船：向右轉。
(2) 左邊後面或正橫的船：向右轉。
(3) 右邊後面或正橫的船：向左轉。

content.english_original: The action shall be taken according to the target position on the radar screen as per the above diagram, other than for a vessel being overtaken. If there is a vessel forward of the beam which is being overtaken, then the overtaking vessel can alter course to either starboard or port in order to overtake the other vessel and avoid collision. Remember, Rule 13 does not apply in restricted visibility.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：按照雷達上的位置去轉向就對了，但「超車」是例外！如果你前面的船是你要超車的對象，那你要向左或向右轉來超車都可以。切記，在大霧裡沒有 Rule 13 (超車規則) 這回事，只有 Rule 19。

content.english_original: You must remember that action is only taken for a vessel which is posing a risk of collision. If there are two vessels on the radar screen, one with risk of collision and other with no risk of collision, then action is only to be taken for the vessel with which risk of collision exists. In the following case (Figure 4f), action would be a broad alteration of course to port, since there is no risk of collision with the vessel on port bow.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：記住，你只針對「會撞上」的船做動作。如果雷達上有兩艘船，一艘會撞，一艘不會，那你只要處理會撞的那艘就好。如果會撞的船在右後方，哪怕左前方有一艘不會撞的船，你還是可以放心大膽地向左轉。

content.english_original: (e) Except where it has been determined that a risk of collision does not exist, every vessel which hears apparently forward of her beam the fog signal of another vessel, or which cannot avoid a close-quarters situation with another vessel forward of her beam, shall reduce her speed to the minimum at which she can be kept on her course. She shall if necessary take all her way off and in any event navigate with extreme caution until danger of collision is over.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：除非你100%確定不會撞上，不然只要你聽到正橫前方傳來霧笛聲，或是你發現前面有一艘船逼得太近閃不掉，你就要「立刻減速」到只能勉強維持航向的最低速度。如果有必要，就把引擎停掉讓船完全停下來。接下來就是要極度小心地開，直到碰撞危機完全解除。

content.english_original: But if the target is not visible on the radar screen and a fog signal is heard forward of beam, that means the target is less than two miles away, which may not be detected by radar, and risk of collision may exist. In this situation a vessel shall reduce her speed to minimum or take all her way off and navigate with extreme caution until the danger of collision has passed.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果雷達上什麼都沒看到，但你卻聽到前面傳來霧笛聲，那代表對方離你不到兩海里了！雷達可能沒掃到他，隨時會撞上。這時候別猶豫，馬上減速到最低或是直接把船煞停，然後小心翼翼地戒備，直到確認沒事為止。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (a) Rules in this part shall be complied with in all weathers.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這一部分的規則，不管天氣好壞通通要遵守。

content.english_original: (b) The rules concerning lights shall be complied with from sunset to sunrise and during such times no other lights shall be exhibited, except such lights as cannot be mistaken for the lights specified in these rules or do not impair their visibility or distinctive character, or interfere with the keeping of a proper look-out.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：關於燈光的規定，從日落到日出都要遵守。這段時間不能亂開其他燈，除非那些燈絕對不會跟規定的航行燈搞混，也不會影響航行燈的能見度或讓人認錯，更不能妨礙瞭望。

content.english_original: (c) The lights prescribed by these rules shall, if carried, also be exhibited from sunrise to sunset in restricted visibility and may be exhibited in all other circumstances when it is deemed necessary.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：規定的燈光，如果在日出到日落之間碰到能見度不好的情況（像是大霧），也必須點亮。其他你覺得有必要的情況下，也可以開燈。

content.english_original: (d) The rules concerning shapes shall be complied with by day.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：關於號型（形狀標誌）的規定，白天必須遵守。

content.english_original: (e) The lights and shapes specified in these rules shall comply with the provisions of Annex I to these regulations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這些規則裡講到的燈光和號型，都必須符合本規則附件一的技術規定。

content.english_original: (a) 'Masthead light' means a white light placed over the fore and aft centreline of the vessel showing an unbroken light over an arc of the horizon of 225 degrees and so fixed as to show the light from right ahead to 22.5 degrees abaft the beam on either side of the vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「桅燈」：裝在船頭尾中心線上方的白燈。它要照亮225度的扇形範圍，也就是從船正前方，一直照到左右兩邊正橫往後22.5度的地方。

content.english_original: (b) 'Sidelights' means a green light on the starboard side and a red light on the port side each showing an unbroken light over an arc of the horizon of 112.5 degrees and so fixed as to show the light from the right ahead to 22.5 degrees abaft the beam on its respective side. In a vessel of less than 20 metres in length the sidelights may be combined in one lantern carried on the fore and aft centreline of the vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「舷燈」：右舷是綠燈，左舷是紅燈。每個燈都要照亮112.5度的扇形範圍，從船正前方照到各自那一側正橫往後22.5度。如果船長小於20公尺，可以把紅綠燈合併成一個燈籠裝在船的中心線上。

content.english_original: (c) 'Sternlight' means a white light placed as nearly as practicable at the stern showing an unbroken light over an arc of the horizon of 135 degrees and so fixed as to show the light 67.5 degrees from right aft on each side of the vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「尾燈」：裝在盡量靠近船尾的白燈。照亮135度的範圍，也就是從正後方往左右各照67.5度。

content.english_original: (d) 'Towing light' means a yellow light having the same characteristics as the 'sternlight' defined in paragraph (c) of this rule.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「拖曳燈」：就是一盞黃色的燈，照亮的範圍跟特性跟前面說的「尾燈」一模一樣。

content.english_original: (e) 'All-round light' means a light showing an unbroken light over an arc of the horizon of 360 degrees.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「環照燈」：就是一盞360度全方位無死角都能看到的燈。

content.english_original: (f) 'Flashing light' means a light flashing at regular intervals at a frequency of 120 flashes or more per minute.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「閃光燈」：規律閃爍的燈，頻率是每分鐘閃120次或以上。

content.english_original: The lights prescribed in these rules shall have an intensity as specified in Section 8 of Annex I to these regulations so as to be visible at the following minimum ranges:
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這裡規定的燈光強度必須符合附件一第8節的要求，最少要在以下這些距離外就能看見：
口語翻譯：50公尺以上的大船：桅燈要6海里外看得見；舷燈、尾燈、拖曳燈、各種顏色的環照燈，都要3海里外看得見。
口語翻譯：12公尺到50公尺之間的中型船：桅燈要5海里（如果船小於20公尺，桅燈3海里即可）；舷燈、尾燈、拖曳燈、各色環照燈，都要2海里外能看見。
口語翻譯：小於12公尺的小船：桅燈2海里；舷燈1海里；尾燈、拖曳燈、各色環照燈都是2海里。

content.english_original:
(d) In inconspicuous, partly submerged vessels or objects being towed:
a white all-round light, 3 miles.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：對於那些不起眼、半沉在水裡被拖著走的船或物體：白色環照燈要3海里外看得見。
口語翻譯：航行中的機動船要亮這些燈：(1) 前桅燈；(2) 在前桅燈後面且比較高的後桅燈（小於50公尺的船不強制裝後桅燈，但你想裝也可以）；(3) 左右舷燈；(4) 尾燈。

content.english_original: (b) An air-cushion vessel when operating in the non-displacement mode shall, in addition to the lights prescribed in paragraph (a) of this rule, exhibit an all-round flashing yellow light.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：氣墊船在非排水模式（也就是浮在水面跑）時，除了上面機動船的基本燈光，還要多亮一盞黃色環照閃光燈。

content.english_original: (c) A WIG craft only when taking off, landing and in flight near the surface shall, in addition to the lights prescribed in paragraph (a) of this rule, exhibit a high-intensity all-round flashing red light.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：地效飛行器在起飛、降落或貼海飛行時，除了一般機動船的燈，還要亮一盞高強度的紅色環照閃光燈。
口語翻譯：(1) 小於12公尺的機動船可以用「一盞白環照燈加舷燈」來代替基本燈光。(2) 小於7公尺且極速不到7節的超小機動船，可以只亮一盞白環照燈，但如果辦得到最好也裝舷燈。(3) 小於12公尺的機動船，如果桅燈或白環照燈真的沒辦法裝在正中央線上，偏一點也可以，但前提是它的舷燈必須合併成一盞，並且盡可能跟那盞白燈裝在同一條前後直線上。
口語翻譯：機動船在「拖船」時要展示：(1) 把原本的桅燈換成垂直兩盞桅燈。如果拖線長度（從拖船屁股算到被拖物屁股）超過200公尺，就要掛垂直三盞桅燈！(2) 舷燈；(3) 尾燈；(4) 尾燈正上方要加一盞黃色的拖曳燈；(5) 白天拖超過200公尺時，要在最明顯的地方掛一個黑菱形號型。

content.english_original: (b) When a pushing vessel and a vessel being pushed ahead are rigidly connected in a composite unit they shall be regarded as a power-driven vessel and exhibit the lights prescribed in Rule 23.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果推船和被推的船硬梆梆地連在一起變成「組合船」，那就把它們當作一艘普通的機動船，照Rule 23亮燈就好。
口語翻譯：如果是「往前推」或是「綁在旁邊拖（旁拖）」，而且不是組合船，那拖船要展示：(1) 把原本的桅燈換成垂直兩盞桅燈；(2) 舷燈；(3) 尾燈。（注意推跟旁拖沒有黃色的拖曳燈）

content.english_original: (d) A power-driven vessel to which paragraph (a) or (c) of this rule applies shall also comply with Rule 23(a) (ii).
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這些拖船如果船長超過50公尺，一樣要遵守 Rule 23(a)(ii) 裝後桅燈。
口語翻譯：一般「被拖著走」的船或物體要展示：(1) 舷燈；(2) 尾燈；(3) 如果拖線超過200公尺，白天要掛一個黑菱形號型。（被拖的船沒有桅燈）
口語翻譯：如果有一堆船綁在一起推或旁拖，就把她們當成一艘船來亮燈：(1) 被往前推的船（非組合船），只要在最前面亮舷燈就好；(2) 被綁在旁邊拖的船，要在屁股亮尾燈，前面亮舷燈。
口語翻譯：那些不起眼、半沉在水裡被拖著走的東西（比如拖木排）：(1) 寬度小於25公尺，前後各亮一盞白環照燈（龍式軟體油船前面可以不亮）；(2) 寬度25公尺以上，兩側最外面還要多加白環照燈；(3) 長度超過100公尺，中間還要加白環照燈，燈的間距不能超過100公尺；(4) 白天在最後面掛一個黑菱形號型，如果拖超過200公尺，前面還要再加掛一個。

content.english_original: (h) Where from any sufficient cause it is impracticable for a vessel or object being towed to exhibit the lights or shapes prescribed in paragraph (e) or (g) of this rule, all possible measures shall be taken to light the vessel or object towed or at least to indicate the presence of such vessel or object.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果被拖的東西真的沒辦法按照規定裝燈或號型，要想盡一切辦法把它照亮，或是讓別人知道那裡有東西。

content.english_original: (i)  Where from any sufficient cause it is impracticable for a vessel not normally engaged in towing operations to display the lights prescribed in paragraph (a) or (c) of this rule, such vessel shall not be required to exhibit those lights when engaged in towing another vessel in distress or otherwise in need of assistance. All possible measures shall be taken to indicate the nature of the relationship between the towing vessel and the vessel being towed as authorized by Rule 36, in particular by illuminating the towline.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果一艘平常不當拖船的船，臨時跑去救難拖別人，這時不用強求一定要掛標準拖船燈。但要想盡辦法（比如用探照燈照亮拖纜）讓別人知道「我在拖船」，避免別人從中間開過去。

rules.Rule_Title: Sailing vessels underway and vessels under oars

content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：航行中的帆船要亮：(1) 舷燈；(2) 尾燈。（帆船絕對不能亮白色的桅燈，那是機動船的標誌！）

content.english_original: (b) In a sailing vessel of less than 20 metres in length the lights prescribed in paragraph (a) of this rule may be combined in one lantern carried at or near the top of the mast where it can best be seen.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：小於20公尺的帆船，可以把舷燈跟尾燈合成一個「三色燈」，裝在桅杆最頂端最顯眼的地方。

content.english_original: (c) A sailing vessel underway may, in addition to the lights prescribed in paragraph (a) of this rule, exhibit at or near the top of the mast, where they can best be seen, two all-round lights in a vertical line, the upper being red and the lower green, but these lights shall not be exhibited in conjunction with the combined lantern permitted by paragraph (b) of this rule.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：航行中的帆船除了舷燈和尾燈，還可以選擇在桅頂掛「上紅下綠」的兩盞垂直環照燈。但注意，如果已經用了(b)款的「三色燈」，就不能再掛這組紅綠環照燈了。

content.english_original:
(d) 
(i)  A sailing vessel of less than 7 metres in length shall, if practicable, exhibit the lights prescribed in paragraph (a) or (b) of this rule, but if she does not, she shall have ready at hand an electric torch or lighted lantern showing a white light which shall be exhibited in sufficient time to prevent collision.
(ii)  A vessel under oars may exhibit the lights prescribed in this rule for sailing vessels, but if she does not, she shall have ready at hand an electric torch or lighted lantern showing a white light which shall be exhibited in sufficient time to prevent collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(1) 小於7公尺的小帆船，盡量裝標準燈，如果真的不行，船上至少要隨身帶一把白光手電筒或白燈籠，快撞上時提早拿出來晃。(2) 划槳的船也可以照帆船的規定裝燈，不然也是拿白光手電筒防身。

content.english_original: (e) A vessel proceeding under sail when also being propelled by machinery shall exhibit forward where it can best be seen a conical shape, apex downwards.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果一艘船升起帆，但同時又開著引擎推進，白天必須在船頭掛一個「尖端向下」的黑圓錐體，告訴別人「我現在算機動船」。

content.english_original: (a) A vessel engaged in fishing, whether underway or at anchor, shall exhibit only the lights and shapes prescribed in this rule.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：正在捕魚的船，不管是在走還是在下錨，只能亮這條規則規定的燈光和號型。
口語翻譯：「拖網漁船」（在水裡拖著網走）要展示：(1) 晚上掛「上綠下白」兩盞環照燈，白天掛兩個尖端相對的黑圓錐（漏斗狀）；(2) 在綠燈後上方裝一盞桅燈（小於50公尺的拖網船可裝可不裝）；(3) 如果船在水裡有前進（對水有速度），還要加上舷燈跟尾燈。
口語翻譯：「非拖網漁船」（其他的捕魚法）要展示：(1) 晚上掛「上紅下白」兩盞環照燈，白天一樣掛兩個尖端相對的黑圓錐；(2) 如果漁具伸出船外超過150公尺，要在漁具那個方向多掛一盞白環照燈，白天掛一個尖端向上的黑圓錐；(3) 如果船在水裡有前進，要加上舷燈跟尾燈。

content.english_original: (d) The additional signals described in Annex II to these regulations apply to a vessel engaged in fishing in close proximity to other vessels engaged in fishing.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：附件二裡有提到漁船靠得很近一起作業時要用的額外信號。

content.english_original: (e) A vessel when not engaged in fishing shall not exhibit the lights or shapes prescribed in this rule, but only those prescribed for a vessel of her length.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果船沒有在捕魚，就不准掛這些漁船專用燈或號型，乖乖掛你這個長度該掛的普通燈。

rules.Rule_Title: Vessels not under command or restricted in their ability to manoeuvre

content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「失控船（NUC）」要展示：(1) 晚上掛兩盞「垂直紅燈」；(2) 白天掛兩個「垂直黑球」；(3) 如果在水裡有對水速度，就要加上舷燈和尾燈。（失控船絕對沒有桅燈！）
口語翻譯：「操縱受限船（RAM）」（除了掃雷船以外）要展示：(1) 晚上掛三盞垂直燈「紅-白-紅」；(2) 白天掛三個垂直號型「球-菱形-球」；(3) 如果有對水速度，要點亮機動船該有的桅燈、舷燈和尾燈；(4) 如果下錨了，除了「紅-白-紅」和「球-菱-球」，還要點亮 Rule 30 規定的錨燈或錨球。

content.english_original:
(c) A power-driven vessel engaged in a towing operation such as severely restricts the towing vessel and her tow in their ability to deviate from their course shall, in addition to the lights or shapes prescribed in Rule 24(a), exhibit the lights or shapes prescribed in sub-paragraphs (b)
(i)  and (ii) of this rule.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果拖船作業嚴重限制了拖船和被拖物轉向的能力，那這艘拖船除了要亮標準的拖船燈（Rule 24a）以外，還要額外掛上「紅-白-紅」或「球-菱-球」。
口語翻譯：從事挖泥或水下作業的操縱受限船，除了掛「紅-白-紅」，如果旁邊有障礙物，還要：(1) 在有障礙物、危險的那一側掛「垂直兩盞紅燈」或「兩個黑球」；(2) 在安全可以通行的一側掛「垂直兩盞綠燈」或「兩個黑菱形」；(3) 就算下錨了，也只掛這些作業燈，不掛一般的錨燈。
口語翻譯：如果潛水作業的船太小，掛不下上面那堆燈和號型，至少要掛：(1) 垂直「紅-白-紅」三盞燈；(2) 白天掛一面至少1公尺高、硬挺的國際信號「A」旗（藍白燕尾旗，代表我有潛水員在水下），而且要讓四面八方都看得到。

content.english_original: (f) A vessel engaged in mine-clearance operations shall in addition to the lights prescribed for a power-driven vessel in Rule 23 or to the lights or shape prescribed for a vessel at anchor in Rule 30 as appropriate, exhibit three all-round green lights or three balls. One of these lights or shapes shall be exhibited near the foremast head and one at each end of the fore yard. These lights or shapes indicate that it is dangerous for another vessel to approach within 1,000 metres of the mine-clearance vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：正在掃雷的船，除了機動船的燈或錨燈外，還要多掛「三盞綠色環照燈」或「三個黑球」。這三個綠燈/黑球要掛在品字型：一個在桅頂，另外兩個在前面橫桁的兩端。這代表警告：其他船靠近我1000公尺以內會非常危險！

content.english_original: (g) Vessels of less than 12 metres in length, except those engaged in diving operations, shall not be required to exhibit the lights and shapes prescribed in this rule.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：小於12公尺的船（除了潛水作業船以外），可以不用掛這條規則裡這麼複雜的燈和號型。

content.english_original: (h) The signals prescribed in this rule are not signals of vessels in distress and requiring assistance. Such signals are contained in Annex IV to these regulations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：記住，這條規則裡的燈和號型只是告訴你「我不好轉彎」，不是在喊救命（遇險）。真正的遇險信號寫在附件四裡面。

content.english_original: A vessel constrained by her draught may, in addition to the lights prescribed for power-driven vessels in Rule 23, exhibit where they can best be seen three all-round red lights in a vertical line, or a cylinder.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「吃水受限船（CBD）」除了亮機動船該有的燈以外，可以選擇在最明顯的地方掛上「垂直三盞紅燈」，白天則是掛一個「黑圓柱體」。
口語翻譯：正在值勤的「引水船（領港船）」要展示：(1) 在桅頂掛垂直兩盞「上白下紅」的環照燈；(2) 如果航行中，加上舷燈跟尾燈；(3) 如果下錨了，除了「上白下紅」，還要亮一般的錨燈或掛錨球。（引水船沒有普通白桅燈！）

content.english_original: (b) A pilot vessel when not engaged on pilotage duty shall exhibit the lights or shapes prescribed for a similar vessel of her length.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果引水船現在沒在值勤，就當作一般普通船，按它的船長掛普通的燈和號型。

content.english_original:
(a) A vessel at anchor shall exhibit where it can best be seen:
(i)   in the fore part, an all-round white light or one ball;
(ii)  at or near the stern and at a lower level than the light prescribed in sub-paragraph 
(i) , an all round white light.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：下錨的船要在最明顯的地方展示：(1) 船頭亮一盞白環照燈，白天掛一個黑球；(2) 船尾也要亮一盞白環照燈，但高度要比船頭那一盞低。

content.english_original: (b) A vessel of less than 50 metres in length may exhibit an all-round white light where it can best be seen instead of the lights prescribed in paragraph (a) of this rule.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：小於50公尺的船，下錨時可以只在最明顯的地方點「一盞白環照燈」就好（不用分前後）。

content.english_original: (c) A vessel at anchor may, and a vessel of 100 metres and more in length shall, also use the available working or equivalent lights to illuminate her decks.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：下錨的船可以開甲板上的工作燈來照明。如果船長100公尺以上，則是「必須」打開甲板燈，把整艘船照亮。
口語翻譯：「擱淺」的船，除了要亮錨燈（或掛錨球）以外，還要加上：(1) 晚上點兩盞「垂直紅燈」；(2) 白天掛三個「垂直黑球」。

content.english_original: (e) A vessel of less than 7 metres in length, when at anchor, not in or near a narrow channel, fairway or anchorage, or where other vessels normally navigate, shall not be required to exhibit the lights or shape prescribed in paragraphs (a) and (b) of this rule.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：小於7公尺的小船，如果不是在狹窄水道、航道、錨地或是別的船常走的地方下錨，可以不用亮錨燈或掛錨球。

content.english_original:
(f) A vessel of less than 12 metres in length, when aground, shall not be required to exhibit the lights or shapes prescribed in sub-paragraphs (d)
(i)  and (ii) of this rule.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：小於12公尺的小船如果擱淺了，不用點那兩盞紅燈或掛三個黑球（但還是要亮錨燈）。

content.english_original: Where it is impracticable for a seaplane or a WIG craft to exhibit lights and shapes of the characteristics or in the positions prescribed in the rules of this part she shall exhibit lights and shapes as closely similar in characteristics and position as is possible.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果水上飛機或地效飛行器因為構造關係，真的沒辦法完全照規定裝這些燈和號型，那就要盡可能裝得跟規定的特性和位置越像越好。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (a) The word 'whistle' means any sound signalling appliance capable of producing the prescribed blasts and which complies with the specifications in Annex III to these regulations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「汽笛」就是指能發出規定聲響、且符合附件三技術規格的發聲設備。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (b) The term 'short blast' means a blast of about one second's duration.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「短聲」就是大約響一秒鐘的短促聲。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (c) The term 'prolonged blasted blast' means a blast of from four to six seconds' duration.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：「長聲」就是連續響四到六秒鐘的長聲。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (a) A vessel of 12 metres or more in length shall be provided with a whistle, a vessel of 20m or more in length shall be provided with a bell in addition to a whistle, and a vessel of 100m or more in length shall, in addition, be provided with a gong, the tone and sound of which cannot be confused with that of the bell. The whistle, bell and gong shall comply with the specifications in Annex III to these regulations. The bell or gong or both may be replaced by other equipment having the same respective sound characteristics, provided that manual sounding of the prescribed signals shall always be possible.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：12公尺以上的船要有汽笛。20公尺以上的還要加個銅鐘。100公尺以上的還要再加個大鑼，而且鑼的聲音不能跟鐘聲搞混。萬一設備壞了，可以用其他有相同聲音特性的東西代替，但前提是你必須隨時能手動把它們敲響。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (b) A vessel of less than 12 metres in length shall not be obliged to carry the sound signalling appliances prescribed in paragraph (a) of this rule but if she does not, she shall be provided with some other means of making an efficient sound signal.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：小於12公尺的船不用硬性規定裝上面那些東西，但如果沒裝，船上也一定要準備其他能發出夠大、有效聲響的工具。[cite: 1]

口語翻譯：當雙方互相看得到的時候，航行中的機動船如果要轉向或倒車，要用汽笛告訴對方：
【一短聲】：我正在向右轉。
【兩短聲】：我正在向左轉。
【三短聲】：我正在倒車。[cite: 1]

口語翻譯：配合上面的汽笛，你也可以用燈光來閃給對方看：
閃一下：向右轉。
閃兩下：向左轉。
閃三下：倒車。
每次閃光大概一秒，間隔也是一秒，兩組信號之間至少要隔十秒。這盞燈必須是白色環照燈，至少5海里外能看見。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(c) When in sight of one another in a narrow channel or fairway:
(i)   a vessel intending to overtake another shall in compliance with Rule 9(e)
(i)  indicate her intention by the following signals on her whistle:
two prolonged blasted blasts followed by one short blast to mean 'I intend to overtake you on your starboard side';
two prolonged blasted blasts followed by two short blasts to mean 'I intend to overtake you on your port side.'
(ii)  the vessel about to be overtaken when acting in accordance with Rule 9(e)
(i)  shall indicate her agreement by the following signal on her whistle:
one prolonged blasted, one short blast, one prolonged blasted and one short blast, in that order.
content.chinese_translation:
口語翻譯：在狹窄水道裡互相看得見時：要超車的船要鳴笛：
【兩長一短】：我要從你右邊超過去。
【兩長兩短】：我要從你左邊超過去。
被超的船如果同意，要鳴笛【一長一短一長一短】來確認。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (d) When vessels in sight of one another are approaching each other and from any cause either vessel fails to understand the intentions or actions of the other, or is in doubt whether sufficient action is being taken by the other to avoid collision, the vessel in doubt shall immediately indicate such doubt by giving at least five short and rapid blasts on the whistle. Such signal may be supplemented by a light signal of at least five short and rapid flashes.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：當雙方互相看得到、而且開得很近，但你搞不懂對方到底想幹嘛，或者懷疑他是不是沒在避讓，這時候要立刻狂按【至少五次短促汽笛聲】來警告他！也可以配合閃五次以上的燈光。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (e) A vessel nearing a bend or an area of a channel or fairway where other vessels may be obscured by an intervening obstruction shall sound one prolonged blasted blast. Such signal shall be answered with a prolonged blasted blast by any approaching vessel that may be within hearing around the bend or behind the intervening obstruction.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：船快開到水道彎角、或是視線被擋住的地方時，要按【一長聲】。如果彎角那邊有對向的船聽到，也要按【一長聲】回應你。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (f) If whistles are fitted on a vessel at a distance apart of more than 100 metres, one whistle only shall be used for giving manoeuvring and warning signals.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果你的船很大，汽笛裝了兩把以上而且距離超過100公尺，發出這類操作或警告信號時只能用其中一把，不要兩把一起按。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: In or near an area of restricted visibility, whether by day or night, the signals prescribed in this rule shall be used as follows:
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：在能見度受限（像是起大霧）的區域或附近，不管是白天晚上，都要這樣按汽笛：[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (a) A power-driven vessel making way through the water shall sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes one prolonged blasted blast.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：機動船在水裡有速度前進的，每隔不超過兩分鐘就要按【一長聲】。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (b) A power-driven vessel underway but stopped and making no way through the water shall sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes two prolonged blasted blasts in succession with an interval of about 2 seconds between them.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：機動船在航行中但已經停下來、對水沒有速度的，每隔不超過兩分鐘要按【兩長聲】，兩長聲中間隔兩秒。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (c) A vessel not under command, a vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre, a vessel constrained by her draught, a sailing vessel, a vessel engaged in fishing and a vessel engaged in towing or pushing another vessel shall, instead of the signals prescribed in paragraphs (a) or (b) of this rule, sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes three blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blasted blast followed by two short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：失控船、操縱受限船、吃水受限船、帆船、漁船，還有正在拖或推別人的船，不用按上面的單聲或雙聲。它們每隔不超過兩分鐘要按【一長兩短】。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (d) A vessel engaged in fishing, when at anchor, and a vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre when carrying out her work at anchor, shall instead of the signals prescribed in paragraph (g) of this rule sound the signal prescribed in paragraph (c) of this rule.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：漁船在下錨捕魚，或是操縱受限船在下錨作業時，不要去敲鐘，而是要按跟上面一樣的【一長兩短】。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (e) A vessel towed or if more than one vessel is towed the last vessel of the tow, if manned, shall at intervals of not more than 2 minutes sound four blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blasted blast followed by three short blasts. When practicable, this signal shall be made immediately after the signal made by the towing vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：被拖著走的船，如果船上有人，每隔不超過兩分鐘要按【一長三短】。最好是在前面的拖船按完之後馬上跟著按。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (f) When a pushing vessel and a vessel being pushed ahead are rigidly connected in a composite unit they shall be regarded as a power-driven vessel and shall give the signals prescribed in paragraphs (a) or (b) of this rule.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：如果推船跟被推的船硬梆梆綁在一起變成「組合船」，就把他們當成一艘普通的機動船，按(a)或(b)的汽笛。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (g) A vessel at anchor shall at intervals of not more than one minute ring the bell rapidly for about 5 seconds. In a vessel of 100 metres or more in length the bell shall be sounded in the forepart of the vessel and immediately after the ringing of the bell the gong shall be sounded rapidly for about 5 seconds in the after part of the vessel. A vessel at anchor may in addition sound three blasts in succession, namely one short, one prolonged blasted and one short blast, to give warning of her position and of the possibility of collision to an approaching vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：下錨的船，每隔不超過一分鐘要連續急促敲鐘約五秒。如果是100公尺以上的大船，要在船頭先敲五秒鐘，然後馬上跑到船尾敲五秒鑼。如果看到有船靠近，下錨船可以額外按【一短一長一短】警告對方「我在這裡，小心撞到」。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (h) A vessel aground shall give the bell signal and if required the gong signal prescribed in paragraph (g) of this rule and shall, in addition, give three separate and distinct strokes on the bell immediately before and after the rapid ringing of the bell. A vessel aground may in addition sound an appropriate whistle signal.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：擱淺的船，除了要像下錨一樣敲鐘（大船也要敲鑼）以外，在敲鐘的前後，都要特別清楚地「單敲三下鐘」。也可以配合按適當的汽笛來警告別人。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (i)  A vessel of 12 metres or more but less than 20 metres in length shall not be obliged to give the bell signals prescribed in paragraphs (g) and (h) of this rule. However, if she does not, she shall make some other efficient sound signal at intervals of not more than 2 minutes.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：12公尺到20公尺的船不強制敲鐘，但如果沒敲鐘，每兩分鐘就要用其他方法發出有效的聲音信號。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (j) A vessel of less than 12 metres in length shall not be obliged to give the above-mentioned signals but, if she does not, shall make some other efficient sound signal at intervals of not more than 2 minutes.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：小於12公尺的小船也不強制遵守這些鐘鑼規定，但每兩分鐘也要發出有效的聲音。[cite: 1]
