content.english_original: (k) A pilot vessel when engaged on pilotage duty may in addition to the signals prescribed in paragraphs (a), (b) or (g) of this rule sound an identity signal consisting of four short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：引水船在值勤時，除了按正常的霧笛，還可以多按【四短聲】來表明身分。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: If necessary to attract the attention of another vessel, any vessel may make light or sound signals that cannot be mistaken for any signal authorised elsewhere in these rules, or may direct the beam of her searchlight in the direction of the danger, in such a way as not to embarrass any vessel. Any light to attract the attention of another vessel shall be such that it cannot be mistaken for any aid to navigation. For the purpose of this rule the use of high intensity intermittent or revolving lights, such as strobe lights, shall be avoided.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：為了引起別艘船的注意，你可以用任何不會跟本規則標準信號搞混的燈光或聲音，或者用探照燈照向有危險的地方，但別照瞎別人的眼睛。別亂用高頻率的閃光燈（像舞廳那種頻閃燈）。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: When a vessel is in distress and requires assistance she shall use or exhibit the signals described in Annex IV to these regulations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：船遇到危險需要救命的時候，要用附件四規定的遇險信號。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: One thing to remember here: 'manoeuvring and warning signals' (Rule 34) used when in sight of one another means in clear visibility only. 'Sound signals in restricted visibility' (Rule 35) will only be used in restricted visibility. Do not get confused between these two types of sound signals, and always use the appropriate signal in the relevant state of visibility.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：作者提醒：千萬要記住！Rule 34 的「操縱和警告信號」只有在雙方看得見彼此時才能用！Rule 35 的「受限能見度聲號」是起大霧看不到時用的。別把這兩種搞混了，要看天氣情況用對聲音。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Any vessel (or class of vessels) provided that she complies with the requirements of the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea, 1960(a), the keel of which is laid or which is at a corresponding stage of construction before the entry into force of these regulations may be exempted from compliance therewith as follows:
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：只要船隻（或該類船隻）符合舊版1960年避碰規則的要求，而且是在這套新規則生效前就已經鋪設龍骨或處於同等建造階段的「老船」，可以享受以下豁免條款（不用馬上改裝）：

content.english_original: (a) The installation of lights with ranges prescribed in Rule 22, until 4 years after the date of entry into force of these regulations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(a) 關於 Rule 22 規定的燈光可視距離要求，可以延後到這套新規則生效後 4 年再遵守。

content.english_original: (b) The installation of lights with colour specifications as prescribed in Section 7 of Annex I to these regulations, until 4 years after the date of entry into force of these regulations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(b) 關於附件一第7節規定的燈光顏色標準，可以延後到新規則生效後 4 年再遵守。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (c) The repositioning of lights as a result of conversion from imperial to metric units and rounding off measurement figures, permanent exemption.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(c) 因為英制換算成公制並四捨五入，導致原本燈光位置產生微小誤差不符合新標準的，獲得「永久豁免」（永遠不用改）。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(d) 
(i)  The repositioning of masthead lights on vessels of less than 150 metres in length, resulting from the prescriptions of Section 3(a) of Annex I to these regulations, permanent exemption.
(ii)  The repositioning of masthead lights on vessels of 150 metres or more in length, resulting from the prescriptions of Section 3(a) of Annex I to these regulations, until 9 years after the date of entry into force of these regulations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(d) (1) 小於150公尺的船，如果因為附件一第3(a)節的規定導致桅燈位置不符的，獲得「永久豁免」。(2) 150公尺以上的大船，因為同一條規定導致桅燈位置不符的，可以延後到新規則生效後 9 年再改。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (e) The repositioning of masthead lights resulting from the prescriptions of Section 2(b) of Annex I to these regulations, until 9 years after the date of entry into force of these regulations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(e) 因為附件一第2(b)節（前後桅燈高低差）規定導致桅燈位置需要重裝的，可以延後到新規則生效後 9 年再改。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (f) The repositioning of sidelights resulting from the prescriptions of Sections 2(g) and 3(b) of Annex I to these regulations, until 9 years after the date of entry into force of these regulations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(f) 因為附件一第2(g)和3(b)節規定導致舷燈位置需要重裝的，可以延後到新規則生效後 9 年再改。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (g) The requirements for sound signal appliances prescribed in Annex III to these regulations, until 9 years after the date of entry into force of these regulations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(g) 關於附件三所規定的聲音信號設備（汽笛、鐘、鑼等）要求，可以延後到新規則生效後 9 年再遵守。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (h) The repositioning of all-round lights resulting from the prescription of Section 9(b) of Annex I to these regulations, permanent exemption.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(h) 因為附件一第9(b)節規定導致環照燈位置需要重裝的，獲得「永久豁免」。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel and you see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你是機動船的當值副官，看到這些燈。這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel probably 50m or more in length, port side on, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這是一艘可能50公尺以上的機動船，露出左舷（紅燈），航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel four points on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你看到這艘船在右舷船頭45度（四個羅經點）的地方。你會怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：我會連續觀測這艘開過來船隻的羅經方位，如果方位沒什麼明顯變化，那就代表有撞船危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位一直沒變，而且距離越來越近了。你現在要採取什麼行動？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 15, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the other is to stand on. I will sound one short blast and make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass well clear of the other vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 15 (交叉相遇)，他在我右邊，所以我的船是讓路船，他直航。我會按一短聲汽笛，然後向右大轉彎，從他屁股後面安全繞過去。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你是機動船的當值副官，看到這些燈。代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel less than 50m in length, underway, end-on.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘小於50公尺的機動船，航行中，正對著我開過來（紅綠燈同時看到）。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel right ahead. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你看到這艘船就在正前方。你會怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 14, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the other is also the give-way vessel. I will sound one short blast and then make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass well clear of the other vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 14 (對頭相遇)，我們兩邊都是讓路船。我會按一短聲，然後大幅度向右轉，安全錯開他。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你是機動船的當值副官，看到這些燈。代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel probably 50m or more in length, underway, seen from the starboard side.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘可能50公尺以上的機動船，航行中，露出右舷（綠燈）。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel three points on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你看到這艘船在你左前大約34度（三個羅經點）的地方。你會怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：我會連續測量它的方位，如果方位沒變，就有碰撞危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。你現在怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 15 my vessel is the stand-on vessel and other vessel is the give-way vessel. I will maintain my course and speed and stand on with caution and continue to monitor the situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 15，他在我左邊，所以我是直航船，他該讓路。我會小心保向保速，並持續盯著他看。

content.english_original: Q. This vessel is not taking any action and getting closer. What will you do now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這傢伙完全沒動靜，而且越來越近了。你現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will sound at least five short and rapid blasts to draw her attention. At night I will also use an Aldis lamp to draw her attention.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：我會狂按至少五次短聲汽笛來警告他。晚上的話，我還會拿阿爾迪斯信號燈（探照燈）閃他來引起注意。

content.english_original: Q. She is still not taking any action and getting even closer. What will be your action now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他還是在裝死，而且近到快撞上了。你現在要採取什麼行動？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 17, since it is apparent to me that the other vessel is not taking any action, I will take the action by sounding one short blast and alter course to starboard to take a round turn and pass astern of her. As per Rule 17 I will not alter course to port for a vessel on my own port side.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 17，既然對方死都不閃，我就要自己來了。我會按一短聲，向右轉一圈繞到他屁股後面去。記住 Rule 17 說的，對方在我的左邊，我絕對不向左轉。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see this light. What do the light indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你是機動船副官。看到這個燈。代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A sailing vessel underway, port side on, not showing optional sailing lights.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘帆船，航行中，露出左舷（紅燈），沒有開額外的桅頂紅綠燈。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 30° on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這艘船在右前30度。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of the approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連續測方位，方位沒變就有碰撞危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。你現在要採取什麼行動？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18 it is my responsibility to keep clear of a sailing vessel so my vessel is the give-way vessel and the sailing vessel is to stand on. I will sound one short blast and make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass well clear of the other vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18，機動船要讓帆船，所以我必須讓路，帆船直航。我會按一短聲，大幅度向右轉，離他遠遠的過去。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船副官，看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A sailing vessel underway, starboard side on, showing optional sailing lights.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘帆船，航行中，露出右舷（綠燈），有開額外的桅頂紅綠環照燈。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 40° on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前40度。你怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連測方位，沒變化就是會撞。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位不變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18 it is my responsibility to keep clear of a sailing vessel so my vessel is the give-way vessel and the sailing vessel is to stand on. I will sound two short blasts on the whistle and make a broad alteration of the course to port and pass round her stern.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18，機動船得讓帆船。我會按兩短聲，向左大幅轉向，繞到他船尾後面過去。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A sailing vessel underway, end-on, showing optional sailing lights.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘帆船，航行中，正對著我開過來，有開額外的紅綠環照燈。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel right ahead. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他就在你正前方。你怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will deem risk of collision to exist. As per Rule 18 it is my responsibility to keep clear of a sailing vessel so my vessel is the give-way vessel and the sailing vessel is to stand on. I will sound one short blast on the whistle and make a broad alteration of the course to starboard.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這絕對會撞。根據 Rule 18，我要讓帆船。我會按一短聲汽笛，然後向右大幅度轉彎避開。

content.english_original: Q. Does Rule 14 apply here?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這裡適用 Rule 14（對頭相遇）嗎？

content.english_original: A. No. Rule 14 is between two power-driven vessels.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：不適用。Rule 14 只管兩艘都是「機動船」的狀況。

content.english_original: Q. Why did you alter course to starboard?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：那你為什麼向右轉？

content.english_original: A. This is the ordinary practice of seamen.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：因為這是優良海員的常規習慣（右轉避讓比較穩妥）。

content.english_original: Q. Could you have altered course to port?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你可以向左轉嗎？

content.english_original: A. Yes I could have, but I prefer the starboard side.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：規定上是可以，但我寧願選向右轉。

content.english_original: Q. Would you consider wind direction when taking action for a sailing vessel?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你在閃帆船的時候，需要考慮風向嗎？

content.english_original: A. If I am on a power-driven vessel I would not consider wind direction. I will keep clear of her.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：我開的是機動船，管他風怎麼吹，我只負責閃得遠遠的就對了。

content.english_original: Aground, Masthead but sidelight out range, object being towed obscured the towing vessel
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(情境提示：擱淺、有桅燈但舷燈還太遠看不到、被拖的物體擋住了拖船)

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see this light. What it could be?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你看到一盞白燈，這可能是什麼？

content.english_original:
A. It could be one of following:
1 A power-driven vessel underway seen from astern.
2 A sailing vessel underway seen from astern.
3 A vessel of less than 50m in length at anchor.
4 A power-driven vessel of less than 7m in length with a maximum speed not exceeding 7 knots.
5 A sailing vessel underway less than 7 metres in length.
6 A vessel under oars.
7 A life raft.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：可能是以下七種情況之一：(1) 從後面看到一艘機動船的尾燈；(2) 從後面看到帆船的尾燈；(3) 小於50公尺船的錨燈；(4) 小於7公尺、極速不到7節的小船；(5) 小於7公尺的小帆船；(6) 划槳的船；(7) 救生筏。

content.english_original: Q. This is a power-driven vessel seen from astern. You see this light one point on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：假設這是一艘機動船的屁股。他在你右前大約11度。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連續測方位，判斷會不會撞上。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近，你現在要怎麼行動？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 13, I am an overtaking vessel in this situation and it is my responsibility to keep clear of the vessel being overtaken. I will sound one short blast on the whistle and alter course to starboard.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 13，我現在是「超車船」，我必須負全責避開他。我會按一短聲，向右轉來超車。

content.english_original: Q. Can you alter course to port?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你可以向左轉來超車嗎？

content.english_original: A. Yes I can. Rule 13 does not specify which way to alter course. The rule only says to keep clear of the vessel being overtaken. I would prefer to alter course to starboard and cross her stern and keep my starboard side clear.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：可以。Rule 13 沒規定超車要轉哪邊，只要閃過去就好。但我個人偏好向右轉從他屁股後面抄，順便保持我右舷的淨空。

content.english_original: Q. Some other night, you see a vessel's side light then the stern light and then the same side light again, two points on your port bow. What would you assume?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：如果某天晚上，你在左前約22.5度的地方，一下看到對方的舷燈，一下看到尾燈，一下又看到舷燈。你怎麼想？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 13 if I am in doubt then I will assume I am an overtaking the vessel and shall keep clear until finally past and clear.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：Rule 13 有說，只要心裡有懷疑，我就乖乖當自己是「超車船」，一路讓他，直到徹底超過他為止。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船副官，看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel probably 50m or more in length, underway, seen from the starboard side.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：可能50公尺以上的機動船，航行中，露出右舷綠燈。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel four points abaft the port beam. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你看到他在你左邊「正橫後」45度的地方。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：老規矩，連續測方位看會不會撞。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近，你要採取什麼行動？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 13, my vessel is the stand-on vessel and the other vessel is to give way. I will maintain my course and speed and stand on with caution and continue to monitor the situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：他在我正橫後方22.5度以上，所以根據 Rule 13，他在「超我的車」。我是直航船，他是讓路船。我會小心保向保速，然後一直盯著他。

content.english_original: Q. This vessel is not taking any action and getting close. What will you do now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他一直逼近，完全沒閃的意思。你怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will sound at least five short and rapid blasts to draw her attention. At night I will also use the Aldis lamp to draw her attention.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：狂按至少五次短聲汽笛警告他。晚上的話還要拿信號燈去閃他。

content.english_original: Q. She is still not taking any action and getting even closer. What will be your action now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他還是在裝死，快撞上了。你現在怎麼行動？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 17, since it is apparent to me that the other vessel is not taking any action, I will take the action by sounding one short blast and alter course to starboard and take a round turn and pass astern of the other vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：按照 Rule 17，既然他不讓，我只能自救了。我會按一短聲，向右轉繞個大圈，從他屁股後面閃過去。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel probably 50m or more in length, underway, seen from the starboard side.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：可能50公尺以上的機動船，航行中，露出右舷綠燈。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel on the port quarter. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你的左後方。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連續測方位，判斷會不會撞。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。你要怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 13, my vessel is the stand-on vessel and the other vessel is to give way. I will maintain my course and speed and stand on with caution and continue to monitor the situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：他在超我的車。我是直航船，他要讓路。我小心保向保速，持續監控。

content.english_original: Q. The other vessel takes action and overtakes from your starboard beam, and then alters course to her port and becomes a crossing vessel. What will you do now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這傢伙開始動作了，他跑到你右舷超車，然後向左轉切過來，看起來變成「交叉相遇」了。你現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 13(d), an overtaking vessel shall not become a crossing vessel with any subsequent alteration of the bearing. It is the duty of the overtaking vessel to keep clear of the overtaken vessel until she is finally past and clear. I will stand on with caution and monitor the situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 13(d)，「一日超車，終身超車」！超車船不會因為改變方位就變成交叉相遇。避讓的責任還是在他身上，直到他徹底跑遠為止。我會繼續小心直航並緊盯著他。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel engaged in towing, less than 50m in length, length of the tow does not exceed 200m, seen from port side, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘小於50公尺的拖船（兩盞垂直白燈），拖線不到200公尺，露出左舷紅燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 40° on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他出現在你右前40度。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連續測量方位看會不會撞。

content.english_original: Q. How will you take the bearings of this vessel?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：遇到拖船，你要怎麼測方位才準？

content.english_original: A. I will take the bearing of both, the tug and the tow lights.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：我會把前面拖船的燈、還有後面被拖物體的燈，兩個的方位都量一量。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing changes slightly and the range is decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位「有稍微改變」，但距離還是拉近了。你現在要採取什麼行動？

content.english_original: A. The risk of collision may exist even if the bearing is changing when approaching a tow. As per Rule 15, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the other is to stand on. I will sound one short blast and make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass round the stern of the vessel being towed.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：遇到這種拖船隊，就算方位有一點點變，還是有可能撞上！根據 Rule 15 交叉相遇，他在我右邊，我要讓路。我會按一短聲，大幅度向右轉，然後從整個船隊「最後面那個被拖的物體」屁股後面繞過去。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你是機動船副官，看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel engaged in towing, less than 50m in length, length of tow more than 200m, starboard side on, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這是一艘小於50公尺的拖船（三盞垂直白燈代表拖線超過200公尺），露出右舷綠燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 30° on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這艘船在你左前30度，你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連續量羅經方位，判斷會不會撞。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離一直拉近，你現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 15, my vessel is the stand-on vessel and the other vessel is to give way. I will maintain my course and speed and stand on with caution and continue to monitor the situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 15 交叉相遇，他在我左邊，所以我是直航船，他要讓路。我會小心保持航向跟速度，持續監視。

content.english_original: Q. But this is a towing vessel. Don't you think that this is a stand-on vessel?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：但對方是拖船耶，你不覺得他應該是直航船（有特權）嗎？

content.english_original: A. The towing vessel and her tow are not severely restricted to deviate from their course so I will treat the target as normal power-driven vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：除非拖船和被拖物因為作業關係「嚴重受限無法轉向（RAM）」，否則一般的拖船還是算作普通的機動船，該讓路就是要讓路。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel engaged in towing, probably 50m or more in length, length of tow less than 200m, port side on, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘可能50公尺以上的拖船（兩盞垂直白燈代表拖線不到200公尺），露出左舷紅燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 35° on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他出現在你右前35度。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and if the bearing does not change appreciably then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連續測方位，看有沒有碰撞危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing changes slightly and the range is decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位「有微小變化」，距離拉近。現在怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 15, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the other is to stand on. I will sound one short blast and make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass round the stern of the vessel being towed.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：遇到拖船隊，方位微變還是可能會撞！他在我右邊，我是讓路船。我會按一短聲向右大轉，然後從「被拖的物體」屁股後面繞過去。

content.english_original: Q. What fog signal shall be sounded by the towing vessel?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：起大霧時，拖船要按什麼霧笛？

content.english_original: A. The towing vessel shall at intervals of not more than 2 minutes sound three blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blasted blast followed by two short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：拖船每兩分鐘要按【一長兩短】。

content.english_original: Q. What fog signal shall be sounded by the vessel being towed?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：那後面被拖的船要按什麼霧笛？

content.english_original: A. The vessel being towed, if manned, shall at intervals of not more than 2 minutes sound four blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blasted blast followed by three short blasts. When practicable, this signal shall be made immediately after the signal made by the towing vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：被拖的船如果上面有人，每兩分鐘要按【一長三短】。最好是在前面拖船按完之後馬上接著按。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel engaged in towing, seen from astern, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：從後面看到一艘拖船（有黃色的拖曳燈在白尾燈上面），航行中。

content.english_original: Q. Can you tell me the length of the tow?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你看得出拖線有多長嗎？

content.english_original: A. No. The information on the length of tow can only be obtained from the masthead lights.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：看不出來。要看前面的白桅燈有幾盞（兩盞還是三盞）才能判斷拖線長度。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 15° on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你右前15度，你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and if the compass bearing does not change appreciably then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認風險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing changes slightly with range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位微變，距離拉近。你要採取什麼行動？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 13, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the other is to stand on. I will sound one short blast and make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass round the stern of the vessel being towed.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：我是從後面超他的車（Rule 13），所以我必須讓路。我會按一短聲向右轉，從後面被拖的船尾繞過去。

content.english_original: Q. Can you alter course to port?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你可以向左轉來超車嗎？

content.english_original: A. Yes I can but I prefer to alter course to starboard to keep my starboard side clear. Rule 13 requires you to keep clear of the vessel being overtaken. It does not give the action to take, nor what not to do.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：可以，但我寧願向右轉以保持右舷淨空。Rule 13 只有規定超車的人要閃遠點，沒硬性規定要向左還是向右轉。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel engaged in towing, probably 50m or more in length, length of tow more than 200m, tug and tow severely restricted from being able to deviate from their course, seen from the starboard side, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這是一組「嚴重受限無法轉向（RAM，紅-白-紅燈）」的拖船隊，大於50公尺，拖線大於200公尺，露出右舷綠燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 45° on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前45度，你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and if the compass bearing does not change appreciably then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing changes slightly and the range is decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位微變，距離拉近，你要怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the other is to stand on. I will sound two short blasts and make a broad alteration of the course to port and pass round the stern of the vessel being towed.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18 階級表，一般機動船要讓 RAM (操縱受限船)。所以我要讓路。我會按兩短聲向左大轉，從後面那台被拖的船尾繞過去。

content.english_original: Q. What fog signal shall be sounded by the towing vessel?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：起大霧時這台拖船要按什麼霧笛？

content.english_original: A. The towing vessel shall sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes three blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blasted blast followed by two short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：每兩分鐘按【一長兩短】。

content.english_original: Q. What is the fog signal of a vessel being towed?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：被拖的船呢？

content.english_original: A. A vessel being towed, if manned, shall at intervals of not more than 2 minutes sound four blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blasted blast followed by three short blasts. When practicable, this signal shall be made immediately after the signal made by the towing vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：被拖的船如果有人，每兩分鐘按【一長三短】，最好在拖船按完之後馬上接力按。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in trawling, less than 50m in length, seen from the port side, making way through the water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘小於50公尺的拖網漁船（上綠下白），露出左舷紅燈，在水中有速度前進。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 30° on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你右前30度，你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and if the compass bearing of the approaching vessel does not change appreciably then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連測方位確認風險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位不變，距離變近。現在怎麼行動？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the other is to stand on. I will sound one short blast and make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass round the stern of the vessel engaged in trawling.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18，機動船要讓漁船。我會按一短聲向右轉，從漁船的屁股後面繞過去。

content.english_original: Q. What is the fog signal of the vessel engaged in trawling?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：拖網漁船起大霧要按什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in trawling shall sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes three blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blasted blast followed by two short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：每兩分鐘按【一長兩短】。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in trawling, probably 50m or more in length, starboard side on, making way through the water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這是一艘可能50公尺以上的拖網漁船（多亮了一盞後桅燈），露出右舷綠燈，水中有速度。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 40° on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前40度。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認風險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離變近。現在怎麼行動？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the other is to stand on. I will sound two short blasts and make a broad alteration of the course to port and pass round the stern of the vessel engaged in trawling.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18 機動船要讓漁船。我會按兩短聲向左大轉彎，從漁船後面繞過去。

content.english_original: Q. What is the fog signal of the vessel engaged in trawling?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：大霧時拖網船按什麼汽笛？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in trawling shall sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes three blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blasted blast followed by two short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：每兩分鐘按【一長兩短】。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in trawling, less than 50m in length, not making way through the water or at anchor.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘小於50公尺的拖網漁船，沒有對水速度（停下來了）或正在下錨。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel right ahead. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他就在你正前方。你怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. In this case risk of collision exists. I will sound one short blast and make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass clear of the vessel engaged in trawling.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這穩撞的。我會按一短聲向右大轉，避開漁船。

content.english_original: Q. What is the fog signal of the vessel engaged in trawling?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：起大霧時這台漁船要按什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in trawling shall sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes three blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blasted blast followed by two short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：每兩分鐘按【一長兩短】。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in fishing, other than trawling, port side on, making way through the water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這是一艘「非拖網」的漁船（上紅下白），露出左舷紅燈，水中有速度。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 30° on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你右前30度。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and if the compass bearing does not change appreciably then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連測方位判斷危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。現在怎麼行動？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the other is to stand on. I will sound one short blast and make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass round the stern of the vessel engaged in fishing.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：Rule 18 機動船要讓漁船。我會按一短聲向右大轉，從漁船後面繞過去。

content.english_original: Q. What is the fog signal of the vessel engaged in fishing?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：大霧時這台漁船按什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in fishing shall sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes three blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blast followed by two short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：每兩分鐘按【一長兩短】。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in fishing, other than trawling, seen from the starboard side, making way through the water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘「非拖網」漁船，露出右舷綠燈，水中有速度。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 20° on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前20度。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and if the compass bearing does not change appreciably then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位不變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the vessel engaged in fishing is to stand on. I will sound two short blasts and then make a broad alteration of the course to port and pass round the stern of the vessel engaged in fishing.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：Rule 18 規定我要讓路。我會按兩短聲向左大轉彎，從漁船後面繞過去。

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in fishing, other than trawling, underway but stopped and making no way through the water; OR at anchor, with outlying gear extending more than 150 metres horizontally from the vessel in the direction of the lower white light.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘「非拖網」漁船，停船沒速度，或是下錨了。而且她有一盞獨立的白環照燈，代表她的漁網（漁具）往那個方向伸出超過150公尺！

content.english_original: Q. Do you know the length of the nets?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你知道他的漁網到底有多長嗎？

content.english_original: A. No.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：不知道（規定只說大於150公尺，沒說上限）。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 20° on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前20度。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the vessel engaged in fishing is to stand on. I will sound two short blasts and then make a broad alteration of the course to port to pass round the red and white vertical lights.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18 我要讓漁船。我會按兩短聲向左大轉彎，繞開他主船體（紅-白垂直燈）的方向過。

content.english_original: Q. Can you cross over the nets?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你可以從他的漁網上面開過去嗎？

content.english_original: A. I shall avoid crossing over the nets.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：我會極力避免開過他的網子（因為網子有多長根本不知道，萬一捲進螺旋槳就死定了）。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你是機動船副官，看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in fishing, other than trawling, starboard side on, making way through the water, with outlying gear extending more than 150 meters horizontally from the vessel in the direction of the lower white light.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘「非拖網」的漁船，露出右舷綠燈，水中有速度，而且有一盞白環照燈，代表她的漁具往那個方向伸出超過150公尺。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 25° on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前25度。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and if the bearing does not change appreciably then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連測方位看會不會撞。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位不變，距離變近。現在怎麼行動？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the vessel engaged in fishing is to stand on. I will sound two short blasts and then make a broad alteration of the course to port to pass clear of the nets.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：Rule 18 機動船要讓漁船。我會按兩短聲向左大轉彎，避開那堆漁網。

content.english_original: Q. Can you cross over the nets?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你可以從漁網上面開過去嗎？

content.english_original: A. I shall avoid crossing over the nets.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：我會極力避免開過那些網子。

content.english_original: Q. How would you cross the nets if it became necessary?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：萬一真的逼不得已非得開過去，你要怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I would stop engines and make sure the propeller is stopped; and then cross over the nets with the help of head reach.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：我會立刻停車，確認螺旋槳已經完全停止轉動！然後利用船剩下的慣性（滑行）輕輕滑過漁網，免得車葉把網子捲死。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in fishing, other than trawling, seen from astern, making way through the water, with outlying gear extending more than 150 meters horizontally from the vessel in the direction of the white light on her starboard side.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：從正後方看到一艘「非拖網」漁船，水中有速度，而且她的漁網往右舷方向伸出超過150公尺。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 15° on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這艘船在你左前15度。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. Since I am an overtaking vessel, as per Rule 13 my vessel is the give-way vessel and the vessel engaged in fishing is to stand on. I will sound two short blasts and then make a broad alteration of the course to port to pass round it.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：因為我是從後面來，屬於「超車船（Rule 13）」，所以我得讓路。我會按兩短聲向左大轉彎，從旁邊繞過去。

content.english_original: Q. Can you alter course to starboard to overtake her?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你可以向右轉來超車嗎？

content.english_original: A. I shall avoid crossing over her nets.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：最好不要，我要避免開過去捲到她的網子（網子在她右邊）。

content.english_original: Q. What is the fog signal of the vessel engaged in fishing?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：漁船起大霧按什麼汽笛？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in fishing shall sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes three blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blast followed by two short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：每兩分鐘【一長兩短】。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in fishing, other than trawling, seen from the starboard side making way through the water, with outlying gear extending more than 150 meters horizontally from the vessel in the direction of the lower white light.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘「非拖網」漁船，露出右舷綠燈，水中有速度，漁網往下方白燈方向伸出超過150公尺。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 20° on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前20度。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and if the bearing does not change appreciably then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連續測方位看會不會撞。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the vessel engaged in fishing is to stand on. I will sound one short blast and then make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and steer parallel to her course; and then once I have overtaken her I will pass well ahead.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：機動船要讓漁船。我會按一短聲向右大轉彎，先跟她平行開，等我超過她、拉開安全距離後，再切過她的船頭走掉。

content.english_original: Q. Can you alter course to port?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你可以向左轉嗎？

content.english_original: A. I shall avoid altering course to port because of her nets.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：我要避免向左轉，因為那邊有她的漁網擋著。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel not under command, port side on, making way through the water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘「失控船（NUC，垂直兩紅燈）」，露出左舷紅燈，在水裡有速度。

content.english_original: Q. What is a vessel not under command?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：什麼叫失控船？

content.english_original: A. The term 'vessel not under command' means a vessel which through some exceptional circumstance is unable to manoeuvre as required by these rules and is therefore unable to keep out of the way of another vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：就是因為發生意外（像車舵壞了），沒辦法按照避碰規則轉向，也無法讓路給別人的船。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 30° on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你右前30度。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the vessel not under command is to stand on. I will sound one short blast and make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass round the stern of the vessel not under command.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18 階級表，大家都得讓失控船。我會按一短聲向右大轉彎，從他屁股後面繞過去。

content.english_original: Q. What is the fog signal of the vessel not under command?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：失控船起霧時按什麼汽笛？

content.english_original: A. A vessel not under command will sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes three blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blast followed by two short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：每兩分鐘按【一長兩短】。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel not under command, starboard side on, making way through the water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘失控船，露出右舷綠燈，在水中有速度。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 35° on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前35度。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel, and if the bearing does not change appreciably then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連續測方位看會不會撞。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離一直拉近。你現在要採取什麼行動？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the vessel not under command is to stand on. I will sound two short blasts and then make a broad alteration of the course to port side and pass round the stern of the vessel not under command.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18 我要讓失控船。我會按兩短聲向左大轉彎，從他後面繞過去。

content.english_original: Q. In which situation does the vessel not under command become the give-way vessel?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：在什麼情況下，這艘拿著免死金牌的「失控船」會變成要讓路的船？

content.english_original: A. In the highly unlikely event of a vessel not under command becoming an overtaking vessel, then as per Rule 13 she becomes the give-way vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這極度罕見，但萬一這艘失控船（可能還有剩一點動力）跑去「超別人的車」！那根據 Rule 13，超車的人就是該死要讓路，失控船這時也得當讓路船。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel not under command, underway and not making way.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘失控船，航行中，但停在水面上沒在動（因為沒看到紅綠舷燈）。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel right ahead. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他就在你正前方。你怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will deem a risk of collision to exist and, as per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the vessel not under command is to stand on. I will sound one short blast and then make a broad alteration of the course to starboard side and pass clear of the vessel not under command.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這穩撞的。根據 Rule 18，機動船要讓失控船。我會按一短聲向右大轉彎，避開他。

content.english_original: Q. What is the day signal of the vessel not under command?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：失控船白天掛什麼號型？

content.english_original: A. Two black balls in a vertical line where they can best be seen.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：在最明顯的地方掛兩個「垂直黑球」。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre, less than 50m in length, seen from the port side, making way through the water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘小於50公尺的「操縱能力受限船（RAM，紅-白-紅）」，露出左舷紅燈，水中有速度。

content.english_original: Q. What do you mean by 'a vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre'?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：什麼叫操縱能力受限船？

content.english_original:
A. The term 'a vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre' means a vessel which by the nature of her work is restricted in her ability to manoeuvre as required by these rules and is therefore unable to keep out of the way of another vessel. The term 'vessels restricted in their ability to manoeuvre' shall include but not be limited to: 
(i)  a vessel engaged in laying, servicing or picking up a navigation mark, submarine cable or pipeline; (ii) a vessel engaged in dredging, surveying or underwater operations; (iii) a vessel engaged in replenishment or transferring persons, provisions or cargo while underway; (iv) a vessel engaged in the launching or recovery of aircraft; (v) a vessel engaged in mine-clearance operations; (vi) a vessel engaged in a towing operation such as severely restricts the towing vessel and her tow in their ability to deviate from their course.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：就是因為「工作性質」導致沒辦法轉向或避讓的船。例如：(1) 放/修航標或海底電纜；(2) 挖泥、測量或潛水作業；(3) 海上補給運補；(4) 航空母艦起降飛機；(5) 掃雷；(6) 被嚴重限制轉向能力的拖船作業。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 30° on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你右前30度。怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離變近。現在怎麼行動？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre is to stand on. I will sound one short blast and make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass round the stern of the vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：Rule 18 機動船要讓 RAM。我會按一短聲向右大轉彎，從他屁股後面繞過去。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre, probably 50m or more in length, seen from the starboard side, making way through the water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘可能50公尺以上的操縱受限船（多亮了後桅燈），露出右舷綠燈，水中有速度。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 40° on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前40度。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位不變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre is to stand on. I will sound two short blasts and then make a broad alteration of the course to port side and pass round the stern of the vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：機動船要讓 RAM。我會按兩短聲向左大轉彎，從他後面繞過去。

content.english_original: Q. What is the fog signal of the vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這艘船起霧時按什麼汽笛？

content.english_original: A. A vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre shall sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes three blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blast followed by two short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：每兩分鐘按【一長兩短】。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre, underway and not making way through water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘操縱受限船，航行中，但停在水面上沒在動。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel right ahead. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他就在你正前方。你怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will deem a risk of collision to exist and as per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre is to stand on. I will sound one short blast and then make a broad alteration of the course to starboard to pass clear of the vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這會撞的。機動船要讓 RAM。我會按一短聲向右大轉彎，避開他。

content.english_original: Q. What is the day signal of the vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這艘船白天掛什麼號型？

content.english_original: A. Three shapes in a vertical line where they can best be seen. The highest and lowest of these shapes shall be black balls and the middle one a black diamond.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：垂直三個號型：球-菱形-球。

content.english_original: Q. Can these shapes be of different colours?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這號型可以是別的顏色嗎？

content.english_original: A. As per Annex I these shapes shall be black in colour.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：不行，根據附件一，這些號型一定要是黑色的。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre, engaged in dredging or underwater operations, probably 50m or more in length, end on, making way through the water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘可能大於50公尺的挖泥船或水下作業船（有另外掛危險側和安全側的燈），正對著我開過來，水中有速度。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel right ahead. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他就在你正前方。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will deem a risk of collision to exist and as per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre is to stand on. I will sound two short blasts and make a broad alteration of the course to port and pass clear of the vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這會撞上的，我要讓路。我會按兩短聲向左大轉彎，避開他。

content.english_original: Q. Can you alter course to starboard?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：一般不是都向右轉嗎？你可以向右轉嗎？

content.english_original: A. No. The two red lights in a vertical line indicate that the vessel has an obstructed side, and that I must keep clear of her port side in this case. The two green lights identify the clear side- which is starboard side of the vessel in this case.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：絕對不行！那兩盞垂直紅燈（在他左舷）代表那邊是死路（有障礙物）。我一定要看著兩盞垂直綠燈（安全側）走，也就是必須往我自己的左邊（他的右舷）開過去才安全。

content.english_original: Q. How shall she indicate the clear side and obstructed side by day?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：那白天怎麼分哪邊安全哪邊危險？

content.english_original: A. Two black balls in a vertical line indicate the obstructed side; and two black diamonds in a vertical line indicate the clear side- where other vessels may pass.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：掛「兩個黑球」那邊有危險，掛「兩個黑菱形」那邊才是可以過的安全區。

content.english_original: Q. What is the fog signal of the vessel engaged in dredging operation?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這挖泥船起大霧按什麼汽笛？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in dredging operations, when restricted in her ability to manoeuvre, shall sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes three blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blast followed by two short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：挖泥船算操縱受限船，每兩分鐘按【一長兩短】。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你是機動船副官。看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in mine-clearance operations, probably 50m or more in length, end-on, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這是一艘可能大於50公尺的掃雷船（因為有三盞綠色的品字形燈），正對著我開過來，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel right ahead. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他就在你正前方。你怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will call the master (not applicable if you are appearing for the Master's Examination) and establish communication with the vessel engaged in mine-clearance operations. I will deem a risk of collision to exist in this situation and as per Rule 18, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre, engaged in mine-clearance operations, is to stand on. I will sound one short blast and then make a broad alteration of the course to starboard, passing at least 1000m clear of the vessel engaged in mine-clearance operations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：我會先請船長上駕駛台（如果你自己就是在考船長就不用講這句），然後試著用無線電跟掃雷船聯絡。這穩撞的，根據 Rule 18，機動船要讓掃雷船（因為它算操縱受限船）。我會按一短聲向右大轉彎，並且確保我離他至少有 1000 公尺以上的安全距離（因為有水雷很危險）。

content.english_original: Q. What is the day signal of the vessel engaged in mine-clearance operations?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：掃雷船白天掛什麼號型？

content.english_original: A. She shall exhibit three black balls. One ball shall be exhibited near the foremast head and one at each end of the fore yard.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：掛三個黑球，排成品字形：一個在桅頂，另外兩個在橫桁的兩端。

content.english_original: Q. What is the fog signal of the vessel engaged in mine-clearance operations?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：掃雷船起霧按什麼汽笛？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in mine-clearance operations shall sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes three blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blast followed by two short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：掃雷船算操縱受限船，每兩分鐘按【一長兩短】。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel constrained by her draught, probably 50m or more in length end on, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這是一艘可能大於50公尺的吃水受限船（CBD，因為有三盞垂直紅燈），正對著我開過來，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel right ahead. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你正前方。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will deem a risk of collision to exist in this situation and as per Rule 18, I shall avoid impeding the safe passage of the vessel constrained by her draught so I will sound one short blast and make a broad alteration of the course to starboard, passing clear of the vessel constrained by her draught.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這會有碰撞危險。根據 Rule 18，機動船要避免妨礙吃水受限船，所以我會按一短聲向右大轉彎，避開他。

content.english_original: Q. What do you mean by 'vessel constrained by her draught'?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：什麼叫吃水受限船？

content.english_original: A. The term 'vessel constrained by her draught' means a power-driven vessel which, because of her draught in relation to the available depth and width of navigable water, is severely restricted in her ability to deviate from the course she is following.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：就是因為船吃水太深，相對當下的水深或水域寬度，讓他很難改變航向的機動船。

content.english_original: Q. What is the day signal of the vessel constrained by her draught?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：吃水受限船白天掛什麼？

content.english_original: A. She shall exhibit a black cylinder.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：掛一個黑色的圓柱體。

content.english_original: Q. What is the fog signal of the vessel constrained by her draught?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這艘船起霧時按什麼汽笛？

content.english_original: A. A vessel constrained by her draught shall sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes three blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blast followed by two short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：吃水受限船每兩分鐘按【一長兩短】。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel constrained by her draught, probably 50m or more in length, port side on, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘可能大於50公尺的吃水受限船，露出左舷紅燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 30° on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你右前30度。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連續測方位，看會不會撞。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離一直拉近。你現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, I shall avoid impeding the safe passage of the vessel constrained by her draught so I will sound one short blast and then make a broad alteration of course to starboard and pass round the stern of the vessel constrained by her draught.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18 我要避免妨礙吃水受限船。我會按一短聲向右大轉彎，從他屁股後面繞過去。

content.english_original: Q. What is the fog signal of the vessel constrained by her draught?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這艘船起霧按什麼汽笛？

content.english_original: A. A vessel constrained by her draught shall sound at intervals of not more than 2 minutes three blasts in succession, namely one prolonged blast followed by two short blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：每兩分鐘按【一長兩短】。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel constrained by her draught, probably 50m or more in length, seen from the starboard side, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘可能大於50公尺的吃水受限船，露出右舷綠燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 45° on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前45度。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測量方位看會不會撞。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位不變，距離拉近。現在怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, I shall avoid impeding the safe passage of the vessel constrained by her draught, so I will reduce my speed in ample time and let the vessel constrained by her draught pass ahead of me.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18 我要避免妨礙他。我會提早減速，讓這艘吃水受限船從我前面先過。

content.english_original: Q. Why would you reduce speed for this vessel? Can you not alter course to port and pass astern of her?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：為什麼你要減速？你不能直接向左轉從他後面繞過去嗎？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, a vessel constrained by her draught is not a privileged vessel like 'a vessel not under command' or 'a vessel engaged in fishing'. As per Rule 8(f)(ii), when taking action to provide safe passage to a vessel constrained by her draught I have to take action according to the rules of this part and since I am the stand-on vessel and the power-driven vessel constrained by her draught is the give-way vessel, and as per Rule 17(c), I shall not alter course to port for a vessel on my own port side. As per Rule 8(f)(iii), a vessel constrained by her draught remains fully obliged to comply with the rules of this part when the two vessels are approaching one another so as to involve risk of collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這是個陷阱題！根據規則，吃水受限船雖然我很尊重他，但他並沒有像失控船或漁船那樣的「絕對特權」。在交叉相遇的狀況下，他在我左邊，其實他是讓路船，我是直航船！雖然 Rule 18 要我「避免妨礙他」，但根據 Rule 8(f)(ii) 和 Rule 17(c)，身為直航船，我絕對不能為了左邊的船向左轉！如果他不讓，根據 Rule 8(f)(iii) 他還是要守規矩（他應該減速）。我為了不妨礙他，我唯一能做的就是減速。

content.english_original: Q. Can you alter course to starboard?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：那你向右轉總可以吧？

content.english_original: A. Yes. If altering course to starboard I will take a round turn and pass astern of the vessel constrained by her draught.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：可以。如果要向右轉，我就會轉個大圈，從他的屁股後面繞過去。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel constrained by her draught in coastal waters. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你自己現在開著一艘「吃水受限船」在沿海航行，你看到這些燈，代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A sailing vessel underway, starboard side on, showing optional sailing lights.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘帆船，露出右舷綠燈，有開桅頂的紅綠選配燈。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 40° on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前40度。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離變近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18(d), any vessel other than a vessel not under command or a vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre shall, if the circumstances of the case admit, avoid impeding the safe passage of a vessel constrained by her draught. So, I would expect the sailing vessel to take action to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18 階級表，除了 NUC 和 RAM 以外，任何船（包括帆船）都要避免妨礙我這艘吃水受限船。所以我預期那艘帆船會主動閃我。

content.english_original: Q. What if she does not take action?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：如果帆船裝死不閃呢？

content.english_original: A. Then I will reduce my speed and let the sailing vessel pass ahead of my vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：那我就只能乖乖減速，讓帆船從我前面過了（吃水受限船不能隨便轉彎，減速最安全）。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged on pilotage duties, underway, starboard side on.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘引水船（上白下紅），露出右舷綠燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel three points on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前大約34度。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位不變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. Assuming this is a power-driven vessel, as per Rule 15, my vessel is the stand-on vessel and the other vessel is the give-way vessel. I will maintain my course and speed and stand on with caution, continuing to monitor the situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：假設他是一艘機動船，根據 Rule 15，他在我左邊，所以我是直航船，他要讓路。我會保向保速，然後一直盯著他。

content.english_original: Q. Why do you assume it is a power-driven vessel?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你憑什麼假設他是一艘「機動船」？

content.english_original: A. Rule 29(a) states 'a vessel engaged on pilotage duty', which means it could be a power-driven vessel, or a vessel under oars, or a sailing vessel not showing optional lights.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：因為 Rule 29 只有說他是「值勤中的引水船」，引水船不一定是引擎驅動的，他也可能是划船或帆船（只要沒亮紅綠選配燈，看起來跟這個一樣）。所以我只能先「假設」他是機動船。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged on pilotage duties, probably 50m or more in length, at anchor.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘引水船（上白下紅），可能大於50公尺（因為前後都有錨燈），正在下錨中。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel probably 50m or more in length, aground.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這是一艘可能大於50公尺的擱淺船（前後有錨燈，外加垂直兩盞紅燈）。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel right ahead. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這艘船就在你正前方。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will stop my vessel and take all way off. I will call the master, do a chart assessment and establish communication with the vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：人家都擱淺了代表前面沒水！我會立刻停車把船煞住。然後請船長上來，趕快查海圖看水深，並用無線電跟那艘船聯絡。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. It could be a vessel less than 50m, aground; OR a vessel not under command, seen from astern, underway. In deep waters it can only be a vessel not under command, seen from astern, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：有兩種可能：(1) 小於50公尺的擱淺船（單一錨燈+兩紅燈）；(2) 從屁股看一艘失控船（尾燈+兩紅燈）。如果我們現在在很深的大洋裡，那就不可能擱淺，所以一定是一艘從後面看的失控船。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. An air cushion vessel or non-displacement craft less than 50m in length, underway, seen from the starboard side.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘小於50公尺的氣墊船或非排水型船隻（有黃色閃光燈），露出右舷綠燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel four points on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前45度。你怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 15 my vessel is the stand-on vessel and other vessel is to give way. I will maintain my course and speed and stand on with caution and continue to monitor the situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這傢伙算機動船，他在我左邊，所以我是直航船，他要閃。我會保向保速，然後一直盯著他。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A wing-in-ground craft operating in WIG mode, less than 50m in length, underway, seen from the starboard side.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘小於50公尺的地效飛行器（有紅色閃光燈），露出右舷綠燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. What do you mean by operating in WIG mode?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：什麼叫「WIG 模式」？

content.english_original: A. A WIG craft will display a red flashing light only when taking off, landing and in flight near the surface.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：地效飛行器只有在起飛、降落，或是貼著水面飛的時候，才會亮起那盞紅色閃光燈。

content.english_original: Q. What are the characteristics of the red flashing light?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：那盞紅閃燈有什麼特性？

content.english_original: A. A high-intensity all-round flashing red light, at 120 flashes per minute.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：高強度的紅色環照閃光燈，每分鐘閃120下。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel three points on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前大約34度。怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18(f), a WIG craft, when taking off, landing and in flight near the surface, shall keep well clear of the other vessels and avoid impeding their navigation. So I would expect her to take action to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18，地效飛行器在天上飛的時候，地位最低，他必須閃開所有船。所以我預期他會自己閃開。

content.english_original: Q. It is apparent to you that she is not taking action. What will you do?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：但他看起來完全沒閃的意思，你怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will sound one short blast and alter course to starboard and go parallel with her course and re-assess the situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：那我就自己按一短聲向右轉，先跟他平行飛/開，然後再重新評估狀況。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel engaged in towing, less than 50m in length, tow length of more than 200m, starboard side on, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：小於50公尺的拖船，拖線超過200公尺，露出右舷綠燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel four points on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前45度。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 15, my vessel is the stand-on vessel and the other vessel is to give way. I will maintain my course and speed and stand on with caution and continue to monitor the situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：他在左，我在右，我是直航船，他要閃。我小心保向保速，持續監控。

content.english_original: Q. This vessel is not taking any action and getting closer. What will you do now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他一直逼近沒閃。你怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will sound at least five short and rapid blasts to draw her attention. At night I will also use the Aldis lamp to draw her attention.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：狂按至少五短聲汽笛，外加探照燈閃他。

content.english_original: Q. She is still not taking any action and getting even closer. What will be your action now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他還是在裝死。現在你怎麼自救？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 17(a)(ii), since it is apparent to me that other vessel is not taking any action I will take the action by sounding one short blast then alter course to starboard and go parallel with her course and re-assess the situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 17，既然他不閃，我只能自己動手。我會按一短聲向右轉，跟他平行，然後再看情況。

content.english_original: Q. Can you go to port?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你可以向左轉嗎？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 17(c) I will not alter course to port for a power-driven vessel on my own port side.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：絕對不行。Rule 17(c) 說了，為了閃左邊的機動船，直航船千萬不要向左轉。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel and you see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel probably 50m or more in length, port side on, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：可能大於50公尺的機動船，露出左舷紅燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel four points on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你右前45度。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 15, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the other is to stand on. I will sound one short blast and make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass well clear of the other vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：交叉相遇，他在右我得讓。我按一短聲向右大轉，從他後面過。

content.english_original: Q. There is shallow patch on your starboard which mean you cannot alter course to starboard. What can you do now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：但是！你右邊有淺灘，不能向右轉。你現在能怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will reduce my speed in ample time.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：那我只能提早減速讓他先過。

content.english_original: Q. Is there anything else you can do?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你還能做什麼動作？

content.english_original: A. I can alter course to port and steer parallel to the other vessel's course and then re-assess the situation. Rule 15 only says 'avoid crossing ahead of the other vessel' and by altering course to port and steering parallel to other vessel's course my action will be within the rules.
