content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：我也可以向左轉，跟他平行開，然後再重新評估。因為 Rule 15 只有說「避免從人家船頭搶過去」，如果我向左轉跟他同方向開，不算搶船頭，完全符合規矩。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You are involved in assisting another vessel in distress. A decision has been made that your vessel will tow the vessel in distress. The length of your vessel is more than 50m and the length of the tow is more than 200m. What navigational lights will you display as a towing vessel?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你在機動船上當班，臨時要去救一艘遇險的船，決定要拖他。你的船大於50公尺，拖線大於200公尺。請問你要掛什麼燈？

content.english_original:
A. If available, I will display three masthead lights in a vertical line in the forward and one masthead light abaft of and higher than the forward masthead lights; sidelights; a sternlight; and a towing light in a vertical line above the sternlight.
As per Rule 24
(i) , where from sufficient cause it is impracticable for a vessel not normally engaged in towing operations to display the lights prescribed above, such a vessel shall not be required to exhibit those lights when engaged in towing another vessel in distress. I will make sure to indicate the relationship between the towing vessel and the vessel being towed by illuminating the towline.
content.chinese_translation:
口語翻譯：答：如果船上有標準設備，我就會掛：前面垂直三盞桅燈，後面一盞高一點的後桅燈，加上舷燈、尾燈，跟尾燈上面的黃色拖曳燈。但如果我的船不是專業拖船，根本沒這些燈，根據 Rule 24
(i) ，救難時不用硬掛這些燈。但我一定會想辦法照亮拖纜，讓大家看懂我們兩艘船是連在一起的。

content.english_original: Q. Can you use a high-intensity, intermittent, or revolving light to illuminate the towline?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：那你能用高強度的閃光燈或旋轉警示燈來照亮拖纜嗎？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 36, I shall avoid use of a high-intensity, intermittent, or revolving light to illuminate the towline.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：不行，根據 Rule 36，為了避免干擾別人，我不能用那種閃來閃去的高強度爆閃燈去照拖纜。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You are in a Traffic Separation Scheme (TSS) and proceeding in an appropriate traffic lane in the general direction of traffic flow for that lane. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你是機動船副官。你正行駛在分道通航制（TSS）裡，並且順著正確的車道方向開。看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel probably 50m or more in length, port side on, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘可能大於50公尺的機動船，露出左舷紅燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel four points on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你右前45度。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位不變距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 15, my vessel is the give-way vessel and the other is to stand on. In this situation I will make sure there is enough room behind my ship and reduce speed to let the other vessel pass ahead of me.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 15 交叉相遇，他在右我得讓。這情況下，我會先確認後面有沒有船，空間夠的話我就減速，讓他從我前面過。

content.english_original: Q. There is a vessel right behind you. You cannot reduce your speed.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：有一艘船緊跟在你屁股後面，你沒辦法減速。

content.english_original: A. In that case I will sound one short blast and make a broad alteration of the course to starboard to pass well clear of the other vessel and, if necessary, go to the inshore traffic zone to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：那我就按一短聲向右大轉彎，避開他。如果必要的話，我會把船開進旁邊的沿岸通航區（Inshore traffic zone）來避碰。

content.english_original: Q. But you are in a traffic separation scheme. Can you go into an inshore traffic zone?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：但你現在在 TSS 裡面耶，大船可以跑進沿岸通航區嗎？

content.english_original: A. Rule 10 does not relieve any vessel of her obligation under any other rule. So as to avoid collision with a vessel on my starboard side, I shall alter course to starboard and go into the inshore traffic zone.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：Rule 10 有說，TSS 的規定不能免除其他避碰規則的責任！所以為了不撞上右邊的船，我還是得向右轉，就算開進沿岸通航區也要轉。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You are in a traffic separation scheme and proceeding in an appropriate traffic lane in the general direction of traffic flow for that lane. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在 TSS 順向車道。看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. It is a vessel engaged in fishing, port side on making way through the water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘非拖網漁船（上紅下白），露出左舷紅燈，水中有速度。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 30° on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你右前30度。怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。現在怎麼做？

content.english_original:
A. As per Rule 10
(i) , a vessel engaged in fishing shall not impede the passage of any vessel following a traffic lane. I would expect the vessel engaged in fishing to take action to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation:
口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 10
(i) ，漁船「不准妨礙」走在 TSS 車道裡的船。所以我預期這艘漁船會主動閃我。

content.english_original: Q. She is not taking any action and getting closer. What would you do now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他裝死不閃而且越來越近。你怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will sound at least five short and rapid blasts on the whistle to draw her attention. At night I will also use the Aldis lamp to draw her attention. I will also inform Vessel Traffic Services (VTS).
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：狂按至少五短聲汽笛警告他，用探照燈閃他，並且打無線電通報 VTS（交管中心）說有漁船擋路。

content.english_original: Q. She is still not taking any action and getting even closer. What will be your action now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他還是不理你而且快撞了。你現在怎麼自救？

content.english_original: A. I will sound one short blast and then make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass well clear of the other vessel and go into the inshore traffic zone to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：只能按一短聲向右大轉彎，閃開他，必要時躲進沿岸通航區。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You are in a traffic separation scheme and proceeding in an appropriate traffic lane in the general direction of traffic flow for that lane. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在 TSS 順向車道。看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. It is a vessel engaged in dredging operations, less than 50m in length, restricted in her ability to manoeuvre, end-on, making way through the water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這是一艘小於50公尺的挖泥船（RAM），正對著我開過來，水中有速度。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel right ahead. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你正前方。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 10(k), a vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre when engaged in an operation for the maintenance of safety of navigation in a traffic separation scheme is exempted from complying with this rule to the extent necessary to carry out the operation. I will make a slight alteration of course to starboard to pass on her port side which is the clear side in this case.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 10(k)，為了維護航道安全而在 TSS 裡面施工的 RAM 有特權（豁免 TSS 規則）。他的左舷（兩盞綠燈那邊）是安全側，所以我會稍微向右轉一點，從他的安全側過。

content.english_original: Q. Why do you make a slight alteration?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：避碰不是都說要大轉彎嗎？為什麼你這次只「稍微轉一點」？

content.english_original: A. To keep my vessel nearly in the general direction of the traffic flow and in the lane.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：因為我在 TSS 車道裡，我要盡量讓我的船頭方向順著車流走，別轉太大結果橫在車道上擋到後面的船。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You are in a traffic separation scheme and proceeding in an appropriate traffic lane in the general direction of traffic flow for that lane. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在 TSS 順向車道。看到這些燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. It is a sailing vessel showing optional lights, starboard side on, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘有開紅綠選配燈的帆船，露出右舷綠燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 40° on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前40度。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：連測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 10(j), a sailing vessel shall not impede the safe passage of a power-driven vessel following a traffic lane. I would expect the sailing vessel to take action to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 10(j)，帆船「不准妨礙」走在 TSS 車道內的機動船。所以我預期這艘帆船會閃我。

content.english_original: Q. She is not taking any action and getting closer. What would you do now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他沒閃而且越來越近。怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will sound at least five short and rapid blasts on the whistle to draw her attention. At night I will also use the Aldis lamp to draw her attention. I will also inform Vessel Traffic Services (VTS).
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：狂按五短聲警告，拿信號燈閃他，並通報 VTS。

content.english_original: Q. She is still not taking any action and getting even closer. What will be your action now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：還是不閃，快撞上了。你怎麼自救？

content.english_original: A. I will sound one short blast and then make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass well clear of the other vessel and, if necessary, go into the inshore traffic zone to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：按一短聲向右大轉彎，避開他，必要時切進沿岸通航區。

content.english_original: Q. Who is give-way in this situation?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：在這種情況下，誰才是名義上的「讓路船」？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, the power-driven vessel is the give-way vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18，機動船理應讓帆船，所以機動船還是讓路船（雖然帆船有『不准妨礙』的義務，但在避碰規則的階級上，機動船地位還是比帆船低）。

content.english_original: Q. Would you take the same action if you were crossing the lane and the sailing vessel was following the lane?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：如果今天情況反過來，是你（機動船）在「橫越」TSS 車道，而帆船是順著車道開的，你的處置會一樣嗎？

content.english_original: A. Rule 10(j) only applies when a power-driven vessel is following a lane and a sailing vessel is impeding her passage. In the case of a power-driven vessel crossing the lane then Rule 18 applies here.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：完全不一樣！Rule 10(j) 只保護「順向開在車道裡」的機動船。如果你是在橫越車道，帆船根本沒有義務不讓你。這時候單純回歸 Rule 18，機動船必須乖乖讓帆船。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You are in a traffic separation scheme and proceeding in an appropriate traffic lane in the general direction of traffic flow for that lane. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在 TSS 順向車道。這燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel constrained by her draught, probably 50m or more in length, port side on, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘可能大於50公尺的吃水受限船（CBD），露出左舷紅燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel four points on your starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你右前45度。怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離變近。現在怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, I shall, if the circumstances of the case admit, avoid impeding the safe passage of a vessel constrained by her draught. In this case I will look around and reduce my speed and let her pass ahead of me.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18，我得盡量避免妨礙吃水受限船。所以我會看一下四周，然後減速，讓他從我前面先過。

content.english_original: Q. But there is a vessel behind you. You can't reduce the speed. What will be your action now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：但你屁股後面有船，不能減速。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will look around and sound one short blast and then make a broad alteration of the course to starboard and pass well clear of the other vessel and go into the inshore traffic zone to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：那我就按一短聲向右大轉彎，避開他，如果需要就開進沿岸通航區。

content.english_original: Q. But you are in traffic separation scheme. Can you go into the inshore traffic zone?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你在 TSS 裡耶，可以進沿岸通航區嗎？

content.english_original: A. Rule 10 does not relieve any vessel of their obligations under any other rule. To avoid collision I shall alter course to starboard and, if necessary, go into the inshore traffic zone.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：Rule 10 不能免除避碰責任。為了不撞船，我必須右轉，必要時開進去是合法的。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You are in a traffic separation scheme and proceeding in an appropriate traffic lane in the general direction of traffic flow for that lane. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在 TSS 順向車道。這燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A power-driven vessel constrained by her draught, probably 50m or more in length, seen from the starboard side, underway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：大於50公尺的吃水受限船，露出右舷綠燈，航行中。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel four points on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你左前45度。怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位不變，距離拉近。現在怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, I shall, if the circumstances of case admit, avoid impeding the safe passage of a vessel constrained by her draught. In this case I will look around and reduce my speed and let her pass ahead of me.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：Rule 18 規定我要避免妨礙吃水受限船。所以我會減速讓他先過。

content.english_original: Q. Who is give-way in this situation?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：那在這局裡，誰是名義上的「讓路船」？

content.english_original: A. The power-driven vessel constrained by her draught is give-way in this situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：吃水受限船是讓路船（因為他在我左邊）。但我身為直航船的義務是「避免妨礙他」，所以我還是得減速。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You are in the traffic separation scheme and proceeding in an appropriate traffic lane in the general direction of traffic flow for that lane. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在 TSS 順向車道。這燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in fishing, other than trawling, port side on, making way through the water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：非拖網漁船，露出左舷紅燈，水中有速度。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 30° on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在右前30度。怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位不變，距離拉近。現在怎麼做？

content.english_original:
A. As per Rule 10
(i) , a vessel engaged in fishing shall not impede the passage of any vessel following a traffic lane, so I would expect her to take action.
content.chinese_translation:
口語翻譯：答：Rule 10
(i)  漁船不准妨礙 TSS 車道裡的船，所以我預期他會閃。

content.english_original: Q. She is not taking any action. What will you do now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他不閃。怎麼辦？

content.english_original: Q. I will sound at least five short and rapid blasts to draw her attention.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：狂按五短聲警告。

content.english_original: Q. She is still not taking any action and getting even closer. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：還是不閃，更近了。現在怎麼自救？

content.english_original: A. I will sound one short blast and then make a broad alteration of the course to starboard side and pass well clear of the other vessel and, if necessary, go into the inshore traffic zone to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：按一短聲向右大轉彎避開，必要時開進沿岸通航區。

content.english_original: Q. Who is give-way in this situation?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這局誰是名義上的讓路船？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18, the power-driven vessel is the give-way vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 18 的船種階級，機動船永遠是讓路船。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. On another day, you are the OOW of a power-driven vessel constrained by her draught in a TSS following a traffic lane. You see a sailing vessel four points on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：假設你現在開的是一艘「吃水受限船（CBD）」，順著 TSS 車道開。你看到左前45度有一艘帆船。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 10(j), a sailing vessel shall not impede the safe passage of a power-driven vessel following a traffic lane. So, I would expect the sailing vessel to take action to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 10(j)，帆船不准妨礙走在車道裡的機動船（CBD也算機動船）。所以我預期帆船會自己閃開。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. On another day, you are the OOW of a power-driven vessel constrained by her draught crossing the traffic lane of a TSS. You see a sailing vessel four points on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：換個情境，你開著 CBD 正在「橫越」TSS 車道，看到右前45度有一艘帆船。你怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 18(d), any vessel other than a vessel not under command or a vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre shall, if the circumstances of the case admit, avoid impeding the safe passage of a vessel constrained by her draught. So, I would expect the sailing vessel to take action to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：因為我是橫越，不適用 TSS 裡面「小船不能妨礙車道大船」的保護規定。但根據 Rule 18(d)，除了 NUC 和 RAM，任何船（包括帆船）都要避免妨礙我這艘吃水受限船。所以我還是預期帆船會閃我。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. You are in the traffic separation scheme and proceeding in an appropriate traffic lane in the general direction of traffic flow for that lane. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在 TSS 順向車道。這燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel engaged in fishing, other than trawling, seen from astern, making way through the water.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：從正後方看到一艘非拖網漁船，水中有速度。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel right ahead. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他就在你正前方。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 13, my vessel is overtaking a vessel engaged in fishing, so it's my duty to keep clear.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：Rule 13 規定，我現在是在超漁船的車，所以閃避是我的責任。

content.english_original: Q. But it's the vessel engaged in fishing that shall not impede the passage of any vessel following the traffic lane. Would you not expect her to take action?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：但是漁船不是「不准妨礙」走在車道裡的船嗎？你不預期他會讓路嗎？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 13, notwithstanding anything contained in the rules of Part B, Sections I and II any vessel overtaking any other shall keep out of the way of the vessel being overtaken.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：千萬別搞錯！Rule 13 的超車規則是「無敵星星」，效力大過其他所有規則。只要你在超車，你就是要乖乖讓路！[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel in a narrow channel. You see these lights. What do the lights indicate to you?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在「狹窄水道」裡。這燈代表什麼？

content.english_original: A. A vessel not under command, port side on, making way through the channel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：一艘失控船（NUC），露出左舷紅燈，在水道裡有速度前進。

content.english_original: Q. You see this vessel 45° on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：他在你右前45度。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will take a series of compass bearings of an approaching vessel and, if the compass bearing does not change appreciably, then the risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：測方位確認危險。

content.english_original: Q. The bearing is constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 9(d), a vessel shall not cross a narrow channel or fairway if such crossing impedes the passage of a vessel which can safely navigate only within such a channel or fairway. So, I would expect the vessel not under command to take action to avoid collision.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：他在橫越水道！根據 Rule 9(d)，橫越水道的船「不准妨礙」只能在水道裡正常航行的船。所以我預期這艘失控船要自己想辦法閃我。

content.english_original: Q. What if she does not take action?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：如果他失控了根本沒辦法閃呢？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 9(d), I will sound at least five or more short and rapid blasts to draw her attention.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 9(d)，我會狂按五聲以上的短促汽笛來警告他（然後想辦法自救）。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. Which side of a narrow channel will you keep your vessel?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：在狹窄水道裡，你要靠哪邊走？

content.english_original: A. I will keep to the starboard side.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：靠我自己的右邊走。

content.english_original: Q. Which types of vessel shall not impede your passage when you can only navigate safely within a narrow channel?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：當你只能在狹水道裡面安全航行時，哪些船「不准妨礙」你？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 9(b and c), a sailing vessel, a vessel less than 20m in length and a vessel engaged in fishing shall not impede the safe passage of a vessel navigating within a narrow channel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 9，帆船、小於20公尺的小船、漁船，通通不准妨礙我。

content.english_original: Q. A sailing vessel is navigating within a narrow channel. Can a vessel engaged in fishing impede her passage?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：如果是一艘帆船正走在狹水道裡面，漁船可以妨礙她嗎？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 9 (c), a vessel engaged in fishing shall not impede the passage of any other vessel navigating within a narrow channel or fairway.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：不行！Rule 9(c) 說了，漁船不准妨礙狹水道裡的「任何其他船隻」，所以漁船連帆船都不能妨礙。

content.english_original: Q. You are OOW of a power-driven vessel and navigating within a narrow channel. There is a power-driven vessel on your port side crossing the channel. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你開機動船在狹水道裡，左邊有台機動船想橫越水道。你怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 9 (d), a vessel shall not cross the narrow channel if such crossing impedes the passage of a vessel which can safely navigate within the narrow channel. I would expect the other vessel to take action.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 9(d)，橫越船不准妨礙在水道裡的船。我預期他會乖乖閃開。

content.english_original: Q. What if she does not take action?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：如果他死都不閃呢？

content.english_original: A. In this case, as per Rule 9( d) I will sound at least five short and rapid blasts.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：那我就連按五聲以上短促汽笛狂警告他。

content.english_original: Q. How would you overtake a vessel within a narrow channel?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：在狹水道裡你要怎麼超車？

content.english_original: A. I would seek permission of the vessel being overtaken by sounding an appropriate signal and wait for the response.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：我會鳴放對應的汽笛向前面的船要許可，等他答應了我才超。

content.english_original: Q. What is the appropriate signal?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：要按什麼汽笛信號？

content.english_original: A. Two prolonged blasted blasts followed by one short blast to mean 'I intend to overtake you on your starboard side'; or two prolonged blasted blasts followed by two short blasts to mean 'I intend to overtake you on your port side.'
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：【兩長一短】代表「我要從你右邊超」；【兩長兩短】代表「我要從你左邊超」。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. The vessel is proceeding in restricted visibility. You observe one radar target at four points on the starboard bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你是機動船副官。船正開在大霧（能見度受限）裡。你在雷達上看到右前45度有一個目標。你要怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will start systematic plot to ascertain if risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：我會立刻開始系統性地標繪（測繪）雷達目標，確定會不會撞上。

content.english_original: Q. How many observations will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你要標繪觀察幾次？

content.english_original: A. I will take at least three equal-time-interval observations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：至少在相等的時間間隔內做三次觀察。

content.english_original: Q. After three observations the plot shows bearings constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：三次觀察後，發現雷達上的方位沒變，距離越來越近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 19 a vessel shall avoid altering course to port for a vessel forward of the beam. In this case I will make a broad alteration of course to starboard and start a new plot.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 19（大霧規則），為了避開正橫前方的船，要避免向左轉。所以我會向右大轉彎，然後重新開始雷達標繪。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. Will you sound any manoeuvring signal while altering?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你轉彎的時候要按「轉向汽笛（比如一短聲）」嗎？

content.english_original: A. No. The vessel will only sound restricted visibility signals. I am already sounding one prolonged blast at intervals of not more than two minutes.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：絕對不按！大霧裡只能按「大霧專用汽笛（Rule 35）」。我早就已經在每兩分鐘按一次【一長聲】了，轉彎不能按轉向信號。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. The vessel is proceeding in restricted visibility. You observe one radar target at three points on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在大霧中。你在雷達上看到左前大約34度有一個目標。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will start a systematic plot to ascertain if risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：開始系統性雷達標繪，確認碰撞風險。

content.english_original: Q. How many observations will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你要觀察幾次？

content.english_original: A. I will take at least three equal-time-interval observations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：至少做三次等間隔的觀察。

content.english_original: Q. Why do you need three equal-time-interval observations?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：為什麼一定要三次等間隔觀察？

content.english_original: A. Three linear observations with equal distances between them shows that the target is on the same course and speed during the period of observations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：因為如果你畫出三個點，連成一直線而且間距一樣長，這才能證明對方在這段期間內「航向和速度都沒變」，你算出來的結果才準。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. After three observations the plot shows bearings constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 19 a vessel shall avoid altering course to port for a vessel forward of the beam. In this case I will make a broad alteration of course to starboard and start a new plot.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 19，前面有船不能向左轉。所以即便他在我左邊，我還是要向右大轉彎，然後重新標繪。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. The vessel is proceeding in restricted visibility. You observe one target on the port quarter. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在大霧中。雷達發現「左後方」有目標。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will start a systematic plot to ascertain if risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：雷達標繪確認風險。

content.english_original: Q. How many observations will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：觀察幾次？

content.english_original: A. I will take at least three equal-time-interval observations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：至少三次等間隔觀察。

content.english_original: Q. After three observations the plot shows bearings constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位不變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 19 a vessel shall avoid altering course towards a vessel abaft the beam. In this case I will make a broad alteration of course to starboard and start a new plot.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 19，對於在正橫後方的船，要「避免朝向他轉」。他在我左後方，如果我向左轉就是朝向他了，所以我會向右大轉彎，並重新標繪。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. The vessel is proceeding in restricted visibility. You observe one target on the starboard quarter. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在大霧中。雷達發現「右後方」有目標。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will start a systematic plot to ascertain if risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：雷達標繪確認風險。

content.english_original: Q. How many observations will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：觀察幾次？

content.english_original: A. I will take at least three equal-time-interval observations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：至少三次等間隔觀察。

content.english_original: Q. After three observations the plot shows bearings constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位不變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 19 a vessel shall avoid altering course towards a vessel abaft the beam. In this case I will make a broad alteration of course to port and start a new plot.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 19，不能朝向後面的船轉。他在我右後方，所以我不能向右轉，我會向左大轉彎，並重新標繪。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. The vessel is proceeding in restricted visibility. You observe two targets on the radar. One target is on the starboard bow and the other on the starboard quarter. Risk of collision exists with both targets. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在大霧中。雷達發現「兩個」目標，一個在右前，一個在右後，而且兩個都有碰撞危險！你怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 19, a vessel shall avoid altering course to port for a vessel forward of the beam and shall also avoid altering towards the vessel for a vessel abaft the beam. In this case since I cannot alter course to port for the vessel forward of the beam and I cannot alter course to starboard for the vessel on the starboard quarter. In this situation I will stop and take all way off, and change the sound signal from one prolonged blast to two prolonged blasts and continue to monitor the situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這是大難題！根據 Rule 19，為了右前的船，我不能向左轉；為了右後的船，我不能向右轉。左右都不能轉怎麼辦？那我就立刻停車煞死！等船完全停下來後，把大霧汽笛從一長聲改成【兩長聲】（代表對水無速度），然後死盯著雷達監控局勢。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. The vessel is proceeding in restricted visibility. You observe one target right ahead. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在大霧中。雷達發現目標在「正前方」。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will start a systematic plot to ascertain if risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：雷達標繪確認風險。

content.english_original: Q. After three observations the plot shows the bearings constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 19 a vessel shall avoid altering course to port for a vessel forward of the beam. In this case I will make a broad alteration of course to starboard and start a new plot.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：Rule 19 說不能為前面的船向左轉。所以我會向右大轉彎，並重新標繪。

content.english_original: Q. Does Rule 14 apply here?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：這不就是對頭相遇嗎？適用 Rule 14 嗎？

content.english_original: A. No. Rule 14 is under Section 2 of Part B which is 'Conduct of vessels in sight of one another'. With restricted visibility the rules of Section 2 of Part B do not apply.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：不適用。Rule 14 是在第二節「互相看得見」的規則裡。現在是大霧看不見，所以第二節的規則全部報廢。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. So which rules of part B would you apply in restricted visibility?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：那大霧時要用 Part B 哪邊的規則？

content.english_original: A. All rules of Section 1, 'Conduct of vessels under any condition of visibility', and Rule 19 of Section 3 apply here.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：用第一節「任何能見度下」的基本功（瞭望、安全速度等），以及第三節大霧專用的 Rule 19。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. The vessel is proceeding in restricted visibility. You observe one target right ahead. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在大霧中。雷達發現目標在正前方。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will start a systematic plot to ascertain if risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：雷達標繪確認風險。

content.english_original: Q. After three observations the plot shows the bearings constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近（情境提示：標繪後發現是對方在你前面比較慢）。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 19(d) a vessel shall avoid altering course to port for a vessel forward of the beam other than vessel being overtaken. WO vector is bigger than OA vector and this is an overtaking situation. In this case I will make a broad alteration of course to starboard and start a new plot.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：根據 Rule 19(d)，對前面的船不能向左轉，但「超車」是例外！雷達標繪算出來（WO 向量大於 OA 向量，代表我的速度比他快），這是我在超車。在這種情況下，我（習慣上）會向右大轉彎，重新標繪。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. Can you alter course to port?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：既然是超車，你可以向左轉嗎？

content.english_original: A. Yes, I can alter course to port. As per Rule 19(d) I shall avoid altering course to port for a vessel forward of the beam other than vessel being overtaken and this is overtaking situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：可以！Rule 19(d) 有給超車開後門，所以我向左轉超車完全合法。

content.english_original: Q. Does Rule 13 apply here?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：那超車是適用 Rule 13 囉？

content.english_original: A. No sir, Rule 13 does not apply in restricted visibility (Section III). Rule 13 only overrides all the rules in Part B, Sections I and II.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：錯了長官！大霧裡沒有 Rule 13。Rule 13 的超車無敵星星只在第一節和第二節管用。現在是大霧，一切都是按 Rule 19 走。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. The vessel is proceeding in restricted visibility. You observe a radar target on the port bow. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在大霧中。左前有目標。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will start a systematic plot to ascertain if risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：雷達標繪確認風險。

content.english_original: Q. How many observations will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：觀察幾次？

content.english_original: A. I will take at least three equal-time-interval observations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：至少三次等間隔觀察。

content.english_original: Q. After three observations, the plot shows bearings constant and range decreasing. Will you have a look at the radar plot triangle and take action?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。你看完雷達繪圖的相對運動三角形後，你要採取什麼行動？

content.english_original: A. Yes. The radar plot shows that I am the overtaking vessel. I will make a broad alteration of course to starboard and continue to plot the target.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：繪圖算出來我速度比較快，是我在超車。我會向右大轉彎，並繼續標繪他。

content.english_original: Q. Can you alter course to port?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：你可以向左轉嗎？

content.english_original:
A. Yes sir. Rule 19(d)
(i)  states that a vessel shall avoid altering course to port for a vessel forward of the beam other than vessel being overtaken. Since I am the overtaking vessel, I can alter course to either side. But in this situation I prefer to alter course to starboard as I am on the starboard quarter of the other vessel and she will most probably alter course to port.
content.chinese_translation:
口語翻譯：答：可以的長官。Rule 19(d)
(i)  說超車是例外，所以我向左向右轉都可以。但我現在在他右後方，如果在霧裡他也發現我了，他可能會想說「不能朝後面的船轉」而向左逃，如果我也向左轉，我們就撞在一起了。所以我向右轉比較保險。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. The vessel is proceeding in restricted visibility. You observe one target right astern. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在大霧中。雷達發現目標在「正後方」。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will start a systematic plot to ascertain if risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：雷達標繪確認風險。

content.english_original: Q. After three observations, the plot shows bearings constant and range decreasing. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：方位沒變，距離拉近。現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original: A. As per Rule 19, a vessel shall avoid altering course towards the vessel for a vessel abaft the beam. In this case since vessel is neither side of my vessel, but right astern, I can therefore alter course to any side. The other vessel is overtaking, and I would expect her to alter course to starboard, so that she can keep her starboard side clear. Therefore I will make a broad alteration of course to port and start a new plot.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：Rule 19 說不能朝後面的船轉。但他現在不偏左也不偏右，就在正後方！所以我向左向右轉都不算朝他轉。因為他是超車船，我猜他會習慣向右轉來保證自己右舷淨空，所以我會向左大轉彎，重新標繪。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. Can she alter course to port?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：那後面那艘船可以向左轉來超車嗎？

content.english_original:
A. Yes she can. Rule 19(d)
(i)  states that a vessel shall avoid altering course to port for a vessel forward of the beam, other than for a vessel being overtaken. The other vessel is overtaking me.
content.chinese_translation:
口語翻譯：答：他可以。Rule 19(d)
(i)  允許超車的時候向左轉。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. The vessel is proceeding in restricted visibility. You observe two targets on the radar. One target is on the port bow and the other on the starboard quarter. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在大霧中。雷達發現兩個目標：一個在左前，一個在右後。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will start a systematic plot to ascertain if a risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：雷達標繪確認風險。

content.english_original: Q. How many observations will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：觀察幾次？

content.english_original: A. I will take at least three equal-time-interval observations.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：至少三次等間隔觀察。

content.english_original: Q. After three observations, the plot is like this picture. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：畫完圖後（情境提示：發現左前的目標不會撞，只有右後的目標會撞）。你現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original:
A. I would like to quote rule 19(d) here:
(d) A vessel which detects by radar alone the presence of another vessel shall determine if a close-quarters situation is developing and/or risk of collision exists. If so, she shall take avoiding action in ample time, provided that when such action consists of an alteration of course, so far as possible the following shall be avoided:
(i)   an alteration of course to port for a vessel forward of the beam, other than for a vessel being overtaken;
(ii)  an alteration of course towards a vessel abeam or abaft the beam.
Since there is no risk of collision with the target on the port bow, I will take action for the target on the starboard quarter. I shall avoid altering course towards the vessel abaft the beam. In this case I will make a broad alteration of course to port and continue to plot both targets and monitor the situation.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：背一下 Rule 19(d)（雷達發現目標，有危險要提早動，不能對前面的船左轉，不能朝後面的船轉）。既然左前的船算出來不會撞，我就不管他，專心對付右後的船。為了不朝他轉，我只能向左轉。所以我會向左大轉彎，並繼續監控這兩艘船。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. You are the OOW of a power-driven vessel. The vessel is proceeding in restricted visibility. You observe two targets on the radar. One target is on the starboard bow and the other on the starboard quarter. What action will you take?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：機動船在大霧中。雷達發現兩個目標：一個在右前，一個在右後。怎麼做？

content.english_original: A. I will start a systematic plot to ascertain if a risk of collision exists.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：雷達標繪確認風險。

content.english_original: Q. After three observations, the plot is like this picture. What action will you take now?
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：畫完圖後（情境提示：發現兩艘都會撞，右前的快撞到了，右後的稍微遠一點而且角度很窄）。你現在怎麼辦？

content.english_original:
A. In this case, as per Rule 19(d)
(i)  I shall avoid altering course to port for the vessel forward of the beam which is the target on the starboard bow; and as per Rule 19(d)(ii) I shall avoid altering course towards the vessel abaft the beam, hence I shall avoid altering course to starboard for the vessel on my starboard quarter. The target on the starboard quarter is very fine on the astern and so reducing speed will not solve the problem. I can see that the TCPA of the target on the starboard bow is much earlier than the TCPA of the target on the starboard quarter, so I will first deal with the target on the starboard bow and make a broad alteration of course to starboard and re-plot both targets.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這跟剛才 S5 的死局很像（右前不能向左，右後不能向右）。而且右後的船在非常靠正後方的位置，就算我減速也沒用（他會追上來）。但我看了「預計最接近時間（TCPA）」發現，右前那台快撞上了，右後的還很久！所以我決定先解決眼前的危機：向右大轉彎閃掉右前面的船，然後趕快重新標繪看情況。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Q. Rule 19 does not state that you have to consider TCPA of the targets when selecting your action.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：問：可是 Rule 19 根本沒叫你要看什麼 TCPA（時間）來決定動作啊！

content.english_original: A. This action has been taken with due regard to observance of good seamanship (Rule 8(a)).
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：答：這叫「優良的航海常規（Good seamanship）」（Rule 8(a)）！規矩是死的，海員是活的，先解決快撞上的才是明智之舉。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: The term 'height above the hull' means height above the uppermost continuous deck. This height shall be measured from the position vertically beneath the location of the light.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：1. 定義。「船體上方高度」是指從最上層連續甲板算起的高度。測量時要從燈光正下方的那一點開始量起。[cite: 1]

sections.Section: 2 Vertical positioning and spacing of lights

content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：2. 燈光的垂直位置和間距。(a) 20公尺以上的機動船，桅燈要這樣裝：(1) 前桅燈（或如果只有一盞桅燈），高度不能低於6公尺。如果船寬超過6公尺，那高度就不能低於船寬，但最高不需要超過12公尺。(2) 如果有兩盞桅燈，後面那一盞必須比前面那一盞高至少4.5公尺。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (b) The vertical separation of masthead lights of power-driven vessels shall be such that in all normal conditions of trim the after light will be seen over and separate from the forward light at a distance of 1,000 metres from the stem when viewed from sea-level.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(b) 機動船前後桅燈的高度差必須確保：在正常吃水差（Trim）的情況下，從船頭正前方1000公尺外的海平面上看過去，後桅燈一定能高出並清楚地跟前桅燈分開。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (c) The masthead light of a power-driven vessel of 12 metres but less than 20 metres in length shall be placed at a height above the gunwale of not less than 2.5 metres.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(c) 12公尺到20公尺的機動船，桅燈高度不能低於舷邊（gunwale）上方2.5公尺。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(d) A power-driven vessel of less than 12 metres in length may carry the uppermost light at a height of less than 2.5 metres above the gunwale. When however a masthead light is carried in addition to sidelights and a sternlight or the all-round light prescribed in Rule 23 (d) 
(i)  is carried in addition to sidelights, then such masthead light or all-round light shall be carried at least 1 metre higher than the sidelights.
content.chinese_translation:
口語翻譯：(d) 小於12公尺的機動船，最高的那盞燈可以裝在低於舷邊上方2.5公尺的地方。但如果有裝桅燈（或 Rule 23(d)
(i)  規定的白環照燈）配上舷燈，那這盞桅燈或白環照燈必須比舷燈高至少1公尺。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (e) One of the two or three masthead lights prescribed for a power-driven vessel when engaged in towing or pushing another vessel shall be placed in the same position as either the forward masthead light or the after masthead light; provided that, if carried on the aftermast, the lowest after masthead light shall be at least 4.5 metres vertically higher than the forward masthead light.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(e) 機動船在拖或推別的船時，規定的那兩盞或三盞桅燈，其中一盞必須裝在原本前桅燈或後桅燈的位置。如果裝在後桅杆上，那最下面那盞後桅燈還是得比前桅燈高至少4.5公尺。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(f) 
(i)  The masthead light or lights prescribed in Rule 23(a) shall be so placed as to be above and clear of all other lights and obstructions except as described in sub-paragraph (ii).
(ii)  When it is impracticable to carry the all-round lights prescribed by Rule 27(b)
(i)  or Rule 28 below the masthead lights, they may be carried above the after masthead light(s) or vertically in between the forward masthead light(s) and the after masthead light(s) provided that in the latter case the requirement of Section 3(c) of this Annex shall be complied with.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(f) (1) Rule 23(a) 規定的桅燈必須裝在所有其他燈光和障礙物的上方，且不能被擋住（除(2)規定的例外）。(2) 如果操縱受限船(紅-白-紅)或吃水受限船(三紅燈)真的沒辦法裝在桅燈下方，可以把它們裝在後桅燈的上方，或是裝在前後桅燈中間的高度，但如果是裝在中間，就要符合本附件第3(c)節（左右偏移）的規定。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (g) The sidelights of a power-driven vessel shall be placed at a height above the hull not greater than three-quarters of that of the forward masthead light. They shall not be so low as to be interfered with by deck lights.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(g) 機動船舷燈的高度，不能超過前桅燈高度的四分之三。而且不能裝得太低，免得被甲板上的燈光干擾。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (h) The sidelights, if in a combined lantern and carried on a power-driven vessel of less than 20 metres in length, shall be placed not less than 1 metre below the masthead light.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(h) 小於20公尺的機動船如果把舷燈合成一個雙色燈，這個燈必須裝在桅燈下方至少1公尺的地方。[cite: 1]

口語翻譯：
(i)  當規定要掛兩盞或三盞垂直燈時，間距如下：(1) 20公尺以上的船，燈與燈之間至少間隔2公尺，而且除了拖曳燈外，最下面那盞燈不能低於船體上方4公尺；(2) 小於20公尺的船，燈與燈至少間隔1公尺，最下面的燈不能低於舷邊上方2公尺；(3) 如果是掛三盞燈，彼此的間距必須相等。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (j) The lower of the two all-round lights prescribed for a vessel when engaged in fishing shall be at a height above the sidelights not less than twice the distance between the two vertical lights.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(j) 漁船的兩盞垂直環照燈（如紅-白或綠-白），下面那一盞的高度，必須高出舷燈。高出多少呢？至少要等於那兩盞垂直燈彼此間距的兩倍。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(k) The forward anchor light prescribed in Rule 30(a)
(i) , when two are carried, shall not be less than 4.5 metres above the after one. On a vessel of 50 metres or more in length this forward anchor light shall be placed at a height of not less than 6 metres above the hull.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(k) 當船上裝兩盞錨燈時，前錨燈必須比後錨燈高至少4.5公尺。如果是50公尺以上的船，前錨燈的高度不能低於船體上方6公尺。[cite: 1]

sections.Section: 3 Horizontal positioning and spacing of lights

content.english_original: (a) When two masthead lights are prescribed for a power-driven vessel, the horizontal distance between them shall not be less than one-half of the length of the vessel but need not be more than 100 metres. The forward light shall be placed not more than one-quarter of the length of the vessel from the stem.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：3. 燈光的水平位置和間距。(a) 裝兩盞桅燈的機動船，兩燈的水平距離不能小於船長的一半，但最多不需要超過100公尺。前桅燈距離船頭不能超過船長的四分之一。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (b) On a power-driven vessel of 20 metres or more in length the sidelights shall not be placed in front of the forward masthead lights. They shall be placed at or near the side of the vessel.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(b) 20公尺以上的機動船，舷燈不能裝得比前桅燈還前面。它們必須裝在船側邊或靠近側邊的地方。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(c) When the lights prescribed in Rule 27(b)
(i)  or Rule 28 are placed vertically between the forward masthead light(s) and the after masthead light(s) these all-round lights shall be placed at a horizontal distance of not less than 2 metres from the fore and aft centreline of the vessels in the athwartship direction.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(c) 如果操縱受限船或吃水受限船的環照燈，是裝在前後桅燈中間的高度，那這些環照燈必須裝在偏離船體中心線至少2公尺的地方（也就是往船舷方向挪一點）。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (d) When only one masthead light is prescribed for a power-driven vessel, this light shall be exhibited forward of amidships; except that a vessel of less than 20 metres in length need not exhibit this light forward of amidships but shall exhibit it as far forward as is practicable.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(d) 如果機動船只規定裝一盞桅燈，這盞燈必須裝在船的「前半截」。但小於20公尺的船不強制，只要盡可能往前裝就好。[cite: 1]

sections.Section: 4 Details of location of direction-indicating lights for fishing vessels, dredgers and vessels engaged in underwater operations

content.english_original:
(a) The light indicating the direction of the outlying gear from a vessel engaged in fishing as prescribed in Rule 26(c)(ii) shall be placed at a horizontal distance of not less than 2 metres and not more than 6 metres away from the two all-round red and white lights. This light shall be placed not higher than the all-round white light prescribed in Rule 26(c)
(i)  and not lower than the sidelights.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：4. 漁船、挖泥船和水下作業船指示方向的燈光位置。(a) 漁船用來指示漁具伸出方向的那盞白燈，水平距離必須離紅-白環照燈2到6公尺。而且這盞燈的高度不能高於白環照燈，也不能低於舷燈。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(b) The lights and shapes on a vessel engaged in dredging or underwater operations to indicate the obstructed side and/or the side on which it is safe to pass, as prescribed in Rule 27(d)
(i)  and (ii), shall be placed at the maximum practical horizontal distance, but in no case less than 2 metres, from the lights or shapes prescribed in Rule 27(b)
(i)  and (ii). In no case shall the upper of these lights or shapes be at a greater height than the lower of the three lights or shapes prescribed in Rule 27(b)
(i)  and (ii).
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(b) 挖泥船或水下作業船用來指示危險側（兩紅燈/黑球）和安全側（兩綠燈/黑菱形）的燈或號型，必須盡可能遠離中間那組（紅-白-紅），絕對不能少於2公尺。而且這些側邊信號的最上面那一個，高度絕對不能高過中間那組信號的最下面那一個。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: The sidelights of vessels of 20 metres or more in length shall be fitted with inboard screens painted matt black, and meeting the requirements of Section 9 of this Annex. On vessels of less than 20 metres in length the sidelights, if necessary to meet the requirements of Section 9 of this Annex, shall be fitted with inboard matt black screens. With a combined lantern, using a single vertical filament and a very narrow division between the green and red sections external screens need not be fitted.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：5. 舷燈的遮光板。20公尺以上的船，舷燈內側必須裝上塗成「消光黑」的遮光板。小於20公尺的船，如果為了符合規定，也必須裝。如果是用單一燈絲、紅綠區塊中間只有很窄分隔線的雙色燈，就不用裝外部遮光板。[cite: 1]
口語翻譯：6. 號型。(a) 號型必須是黑色的，尺寸如下：(1) 球體直徑大於等於0.6公尺；(2) 圓錐體底邊直徑大於等於0.6公尺，高度等於直徑；(3) 圓柱體直徑大於等於0.6公尺，高度是直徑的兩倍；(4) 菱形號型是由兩個圓錐體底對底合在一起組成。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (b) The vertical distance between shapes shall be at least 1.5 metres.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(b) 號型跟號型之間的垂直距離，至少要1.5公尺。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (c) In a vessel of less than 20 metres in length shapes of lesser dimensions but commensurate with the size of the vessel may be used and the distance apart may be correspondingly reduced.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(c) 小於20公尺的船，可以用比較小的號型（但要跟船的比例相符），而且號型的間距也可以縮小。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
The chromaticity of all navigation lights shall conform to the following standards, which lie within the boundaries of the area of the diagram specified for each colour by the International Commission on Illumination (CIE).
The boundaries of the area for each colour are given by indicating the corner co-ordinates, which are as follows:
Table AX 1 Colour specification of lights: corner coordinates
(i)   White: X (0.525, 0.525, 0.452, 0.310, 0.310, 0.443), Y (0.382, 0.440, 0.440, 0.348, 0.283, 0.382)
(ii)  Green: X (0.028, 0.009, 0.300, 0.203), Y (0.385, 0.723, 0.511, 0.356)
(iii)  Red: X (0.680, 0.660, 0.735, 0.721), Y (0.320, 0.320, 0.265, 0.259)
(iv) Yellow: X (0.612, 0.618, 0.575, 0.575), Y (0.382, 0.382, 0.425, 0.406)
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：7. 燈光顏色標準。所有航行燈的顏色都要符合國際照明委員會 (CIE) 的標準座標範圍（白、綠、紅、黃色的座標值如上）。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (a) The minimum luminous intensity of lights shall be calculated by using I = 3.43 x 10^6 x T x D^2 x K^-D where I is luminous intensity in candelas under service conditions, T is threshold factor 2 x 10^-7 lux, D is range of visibility (luminous range) of the light in nautical miles, and K is atmospheric transmissivity. For prescribed lights the value of K shall be 0.8, corresponding to a meteorological visibility of approximately 13 nautical miles.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：8. 燈光強度。(a) 最低亮度用這個公式算。大氣透射率 K 值設為 0.8，大約等於能見度13海里的天氣。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(b) A selection of figures derived from the formula is given in the following table:

Range of visibility (luminous range) of light in nautical miles D | Luminous intensity of light in candelas for K= 0.8

content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(b) 根據公式算出來的發光強度對照表（距離 vs 坎德拉值）。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Note: The maximum luminous intensity of navigation lights should be limited to avoid undue glare. This shall not be achieved by a variable control of the luminous intensity.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：註：航行燈的最大強度應該要有限制，免得太亮刺眼。但不能裝那種可以隨便調亮暗的開關來控制亮度。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(a) 
(i)  In the forward direction, sidelights as fitted on the vessel shall show the minimum required intensities. The intensities shall decrease to reach practical cut-off between 1 degree and 3 degrees outside the prescribed sectors.
(ii)  For stern lights and masthead lights at 22.5 degrees abaft the beam for sidelights, the minimum required intensities shall be maintained over the arc of the horizon up to 5 degrees within the limits of the sectors prescribed in Rule 21. From 5 degrees within the prescribed sectors the intensity may decrease by 50 per cent up to the prescribed limits: it shall decrease steadily to reach practical cut-off at not more than 5 degrees outside the prescribed sectors.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：9. 水平照角。(a)(1) 舷燈朝正前方的亮度要夠。超出規定角度外1到3度之間，亮度要快速衰減到看不見。(2) 尾燈、桅燈和舷燈朝向正橫後方22.5度的那一面，在接近邊界5度內要維持亮度。到了邊界5度以內可以減弱50%，但在超出邊界最多5度內，必須穩定衰減到看不見。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(b) 
(i)  All-round lights shall be so located as not to be obscured by masts, topmasts or structures within angular sectors of more than 6 degrees, except anchor lights prescribed in Rule 30, which need not be placed at an impracticable height above the hull.
(ii)  If it is impracticable to comply with paragraph (b)
(i)  of this section by exhibiting only one all-round light, two all-round lights shall be used suitably positioned or screened so that they appear, as far as practicable, as one light at a distance of one mile.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(b)(1) 環照燈被桅杆或結構擋住的死角不能超過6度（錨燈除外，因為錨燈沒必要裝到太誇張的高）。(2) 如果一盞環照燈沒辦法把死角壓在6度內，就要裝兩盞環照燈，並小心調整，讓它們在1海里外看起來像是一盞燈。[cite: 1]
口語翻譯：10. 垂直照角。(a) 帆船以外的船隻：(1) 水平線上下各5度內維持最低亮度；(2) 水平線上下各7.5度內維持最低亮度的 60%。[cite: 1]
口語翻譯：(b) 航行中的帆船因為會傾斜：(1) 水平線上下各5度內維持最低亮度；(2) 放寬到水平線上下各25度內維持最低亮度的 50%。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (c) In the case of lights other than electric these specifications shall be met as closely as possible.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(c) 如果不是電燈（如油燈），盡可能符合這些要求。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Non-electric lights shall so far as practicable comply with the minimum intensities, as specified in the table given in Section 8 of this Annex.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：11. 非電燈的強度。非電燈也要盡量符合第8節表格的最低亮度要求。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2(f) of this Annex, the manoeuvring light described in Rule 34(b) shall be placed in the same fore and aft vertical plane as the masthead light or lights and, where practicable, at a minimum height of 2 metres vertically above the forward masthead light, provided that it shall be carried not less than 2 metres vertically above or below the after masthead light. On a vessel where only one masthead light is carried the manoeuvring light, if fitted, shall be carried where it can best be seen, not less than 2 metres vertically apart from the masthead light.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：12. 操縱信號燈。Rule 34(b)的操縱信號燈必須跟桅燈在同一個前後面上。盡量裝在前桅燈正上方至少2公尺處，且跟後桅燈的上下距離不能小於2公尺。如果船只有一盞桅燈，操縱信號燈要裝在最明顯的地方，且垂直距離桅燈至少2公尺。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(a) The masthead light of high speed craft may be placed at a height related to the breadth of the craft lower than that prescribed in paragraph 2(a)
(i)  of this Annex, provided that the base angle of the isosceles triangles formed by the sidelights and masthead light, when seen in end elevation, is not less than 27 degrees.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：13. 高速船。(a) 高速船的桅燈可以裝得比第2(a)(1)節規定的低，條件是：從正前方看，左右舷燈跟桅燈連起來的等腰三角形，底角不能小於27度。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (b) On high speed craft of 50m or more in length, the vertical separation between foremast and mainmast light of 4.5m required by paragraph 2(a)(ii) of this annex may be modified provided that such distance shall not be less than the value determined by the following formula: y = (a + 17 Ψ) C / 1000 + 2 Where y is the height of the mainmast light above the foremast light in metres, a is the height of the foremast light above the water surface in service condition in metres, C is the trim in service condition in degrees, and Ψ is the horizontal separation of masthead lights in metres. * Refer to the International Code of Safety for High-Speed Craft, 1994 and the International Code of Safety for High-Speed Craft, 2000.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(b) 50公尺以上的高速船，前後桅燈的高度差可以小於4.5公尺，只要不小於代入這個公式算出來的值就好。* 參考高速船安全國際規則。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: The construction of lights and shapes and the installation of lights on board the vessel shall be to the satisfaction of the appropriate authority of the state whose flag the vessel is entitled to fly.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：14. 批准。燈光和號型的製造跟安裝，必須通過船籍國主管機關的檢驗合格。[cite: 1]

sections.Section: ANNEX II: ADDITIONAL SIGNALS FOR FISHING VESSELS FISHING IN CLOSE PROXIMITY

content.english_original:
1 General
The lights mentioned herein shall, if exhibited in pursuance of Rule 26(d), be placed where they can best be seen. They shall be at least 0.9 metre apart but at a lower level than lights prescribed in Rule 26(b)
(i)  and (c)
(i) . The lights shall be visible all round the horizon at a distance of at least 1 mile but at a lesser distance than the lights prescribed by these rules for fishing vessels.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：附件二：漁船近距離密集作業時的額外信號。1. 總則。如果照 Rule 26(d) 規定要掛這些額外的燈，要掛在最明顯的地方。燈跟燈之間至少要隔 0.9 公尺，而且高度要比原本漁船的標準環照燈（紅-白或綠-白）低。這些燈必須是1海里外就能看見的環照燈，但能見度不能蓋過漁船原本的主燈。[cite: 1]
口語翻譯：2. 拖網漁船的信號。(a) 20公尺以上的拖網船（不管拖底網還是浮網）：(1) 正在「放網」時：掛垂直「白-白」燈；(2) 正在「收網」時：掛垂直「白-紅」燈；(3) 網子「卡住」障礙物時：掛垂直「紅-紅」燈。[cite: 1]
口語翻譯：(b) 20公尺以上「雙船拖網（兩艘船拉一張網）」的船：(1) 晚上要拿探照燈照向前方，並照向你的好搭檔（另一艘船）的方向；(2) 在放網、收網或卡網的時候，一樣掛上面 2(a) 規定的垂直燈號。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: (c) A vessel of less than 20 metres in length engaged in trawling, whether using demersal or pelagic gear or engaged in pair trawling, may exhibit the lights prescribed in paragraphs (a) or (b) of this section, as appropriate.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(c) 小於20公尺的拖網船，也可以選擇掛上面 (a) 或 (b) 規定的這些信號燈。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
3 Signals for purse seiners
Vessels engaged in fishing with purse seine gear may exhibit two yellow lights in a vertical line. These lights shall flash alternately every second and with equal light and occultation duration. These lights may be exhibited only when the vessel is hampered by its fishing gear.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：3. 圍網漁船的信號。用圍網捕魚的船，可以掛垂直兩盞「黃色燈」。這兩盞黃燈要每一秒「輪流閃爍」（亮暗時間一樣長）。記住，只有當漁具阻礙了船隻行動時，才能掛這個信號。[cite: 1]

sections.Section: ANNEX III: TECHNICAL DETAILS OF SOUND SIGNAL APPLIANCES

content.english_original:
1 Whistles
(a) Frequencies and range of audibility
The fundamental frequency of the signal shall lie within the range 70-700Hz.
The range of audibility of the signal from a whistle shall be determined by those frequencies, which may include the fundamental and/or one or more higher frequencies, which lie within the range 180-700Hz (+/- 1%) for a vessel of 20m or more in length, or 180-2,100Hz (+/- 1%) for a vessel of less than 20m in length and which provide the sound pressure levels specified in paragraph 1(c) below.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：附件三：聲音信號設備技術細節。1. 汽笛。(a) 頻率跟聽得見的距離。汽笛的基本頻率必須在 70-700 赫茲之間。大船（20公尺以上）頻率範圍在 180-700 赫茲，小船（小於20公尺）在 180-2100 赫茲。[cite: 1]
口語翻譯：(b) 頻率限制。船越大，汽笛聲要越低沉：(1) 200公尺以上巨輪：70-200 赫茲；(2) 75到200公尺的大船：130-350 赫茲；(3) 小於75公尺的船：250-700 赫茲。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(c) Sound signal intensity and range of audibility
A whistle fitted in a vessel shall provide, in the direction of maximum intensity of the whistle and at a distance of 1 metre from it, a sound pressure level in at least one 1/3rd-octave band within the range of frequencies 180-700Hz (+/- 1%) for a vessel of 20m or more in length, or 180-2,100Hz (+/- 1%) for a vessel of less than 20m in length, of not less than the appropriate figure given in the table below.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(c) 音量跟距離。汽笛的音量必須符合標準表（Table AX3）的要求。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: The range of audibility in the table above is for information and is approximately the range at which a whistle may be heard on its forward axis with 90 per cent probability in conditions of still air on board a vessel having average background noise level at the listening posts (taken to be 68dB in the octave band centred on 250Hz and 63dB in the octave band centred on 500Hz). In practice the range at which a whistle may be heard is extremely variable and depends critically on weather conditions; the values given can be regarded as typical but under conditions of strong wind or high ambient noise level at the listening post the range may be much reduced.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：這些「聽得到的距離」只是無風無浪、背景噪音一般時的理想值。實際上如果狂風暴雨或周圍太吵，聽得到的距離會大打折扣。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(d) Directional properties
The sound pressure level of a directional whistle shall be not more than 4dB below the prescribed sound pressure level on the axis at any direction in the horizontal plane within +/- 45 degrees of the axis. The sound pressure level at any other direction in the horizontal plane shall be not more than 10dB below the prescribed sound pressure level on the axis, so that the range in any direction will be at least half the range on the forward axis. The sound pressure level shall be measured in that 1/3rd-octave band which determines the audibility range.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(d) 方向性。就算是用指向性的汽笛，正前方正負45度內的音量也不能衰減超過 4 分貝。其他任何方向的音量不能衰減超過 10 分貝，確保你背後的人也能在至少一半的距離外聽到你的汽笛聲。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(e) Positioning of whistles
When a directional whistle is to be used as the only whistle on a vessel, it shall be installed with its maximum intensity directed straight ahead.
A whistle shall be placed as high as practicable on a vessel, in order to reduce interception of the emitted sound by obstructions and also to minimize hearing damage risk to personnel. The sound pressure level of the vessel's own signal at listening posts shall not exceed 110dB (A) and so far as practicable should not exceed 100dB (A).
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(e) 安裝位置。如果全船只有一把指向性汽笛，它必須對準正前方。汽笛要裝得「越高越好」，這樣聲音才不會被擋住，而且才不會把甲板上的船員震聾（瞭望哨的音量不能超過 110 分貝，最好壓在 100 分貝以下）。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(f) Fitting of more than one whistle
If whistles are fitted at a distance apart of more than 100 metres, it shall be so arranged that they are not sounded simultaneously.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(f) 裝超過一把汽笛。如果兩把汽笛相距超過 100 公尺，絕對不要把它們設定成同時響（會造成混淆）。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(g) Combined whistle systems
If due to the presence of obstructions the sound field of a single whistle or one of the whistles referred to in paragraph (f) above is likely to have a zone of greatly reduced signal level it is recommended that a combined whistle system be fitted so as to overcome this reduction. For the purposes of the rules a combined whistle system is to be regarded as a single whistle. The whistles of a combined system shall be located at a distance apart of not more than 100 metres and arranged to be sounded simultaneously. The frequency of any one whistle shall differ from those of the others by at least OHz.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(g) 組合汽笛。如果船身建築擋住了聲音，建議裝一套「組合汽笛」。這套系統在法規上算作「一把汽笛」。裡面的汽笛間距不能超過 100 公尺，而且要「同時響」。為了避免聲音互相干涉，它們彼此的頻率要有差異（原書寫 OHz，但實際上應該是有規定的赫茲差距）。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
2 Bell or gong
(a) Intensity of signal
A bell or gong or other device having similar sound characteristics shall produce a sound pressure level of not less than 110dB at a distance of 1 metre from it.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：2. 鐘或鑼。(a) 音量。在1公尺外量測，音量不能低於 110 分貝。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
(b) Construction
Bells and gongs shall be made of corrosion-resistant material and designed to give a clear tone. The diameter of the mouth of the bell shall be not less than 300mm for vessels of 20 metres or more in length. Where practicable, a power-driven bell striker is recommended to ensure constant force but manual operation shall be possible. The mass of the striker shall be not less than 3 per cent of the mass of the bell.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：(b) 構造。必須防鏽，聲音要清脆。20公尺以上的船，鐘口直徑不能小於30公分（300mm）。建議用電動敲鐘器（力道才會平均），但一定要保留手動敲鐘的功能。敲鐘錘的重量不能輕於整個鐘重量的 3%。[cite: 1]

content.english_original:
3 Approval
The construction of sound signal appliances, their performance and their installation on board the vessel shall be to the satisfaction of the appropriate authority of the state whose flag the vessel is entitled to fly.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：3. 批准。這些設備的製造、效能和安裝，都要通過船籍國主管機關的檢驗。[cite: 1]

口語翻譯：附件四：遇險信號。1. 只要看到下面這些信號的其中一個或多個，就代表有人在喊救命（遇險需要援助）：
(a) 每隔約一分鐘放炮或發出爆炸聲；
(b) 霧笛一直狂響不停；
(c) 連續發射會噴出紅星的火箭或信號彈；
(d) 摩斯密碼打出 SOS（三短 三長 三短）；
(e) 用無線電大喊「Mayday」；
(f) 掛出國際信號旗 N 旗和 C 旗（N.C.）；
(g) 掛出一面方形旗子，上面或下面配一個黑球（或長得像球的東西）；
(h) 船上放火（像是燒瀝青桶或油桶）；
(i)   打紅色的降落傘火箭信號彈或拿紅色手持火焰信號；
(j) 放橘色的煙霧信號；
(k) 人站在那邊，兩手伸直往兩側緩慢地上下揮動；
(l) 用無線電 DSC 打遇險警報（VHF 70頻道，或是各中高頻遇險頻道）；
(m) 用 Inmarsat 衛星打船對岸遇險警報；
(n) 應急指位無線電標示（EPIRB）發出的信號；
(o) 雷達搜救雷達詢答機（SART）等發出的信號。[cite: 1]

content.english_original: 2. The use or exhibition of any of the foregoing signals except for the purpose of indicating distress and need of assistance and the use of other signals which may be confused with any of the above signals is prohibited.
content.chinese_translation: 口語翻譯：2. 警告：這些信號除了真的遇到危險要喊救命之外，絕對不准亂用！也不准用任何長得很像這些信號的東西去混淆視聽。[cite: 1]

口語翻譯：3. 請多留意國際信號代碼和商船搜救手冊裡的相關規定，特別是：
(a) 在甲板鋪一塊橘色帆布，上面畫黑色的正方形跟圓形（為了讓飛機從天上認出你）；
(b) 在水裡撒染色劑（Dye marker）。[cite: 1]
